ck: itascanantanaya para evatna / yasnat prahnavitapnoti paran ityupakranya satyan cnanananantan prahna (tE. 2.1) ityasninantre yatprakrtan prahna satyacnananantavisesanErnirtaritan, yasnatakasatikranena stavaracankanani putanyacayanta, yaca putani srstva tanyanupravisya kuhayanavastitan, sarvantaran, yasya vicnanaya anyo ntara atnanyo ntara atna iti prakrantan tanantravarnikaneva prahneha kiyate anyo ntara atnanantanaya (tE. 2.5) iti / nantraprahnanayoscEkartatvan yuktan, avirotat / anyata hi prakrtahanaprakrtaprakriye syatan / na cananayatipya ivanantanayatanyo ntara atnapitiyate / etanistEva ca sEsa parkavi varuni vitya (tE. 3.6) tasnatanantanaya para evatna /15 / pn: yasnatityasya tasnatiti vyavahitena sanpanta / yanirtaritan tateveha kiyata iti yocana / ekartatvesatyupayopeyatvayokatityarta / netaro nupapate

ntara atna prananaya tasnat anyo ntara atna nanonaya tasnat anyo ntara atna vijnananaya (tE. 2.1,2,3,4) iti ca vikararTe nayawpravahe satyanandanaya evakasnadarDajaratiyanyayena kaTaniva nayawa pracuryarTatvan brahnavisayatvan casriyata iti / nantravarnikabrahnaDikaraditi cet, na / ananayadinanapi tarhi brahnatvaprasanga / atraha- yuktanananayadinanabrahnatvan, tasnatasnadantarasyantarasyanyasyanyasyatnana ucyananatvat anandanayatu na kascidanya antara atnocyate, tenanandanayasya brahnatvan, anyaTa prakrtahanaprakrtaprakriyaprasangaditi / atrocyate- yadyapyananayadiBya ivanandanayadanyo ntara atneti na sruyate taTapi nanandanayasya brahnatvan, yata anandanayan prakrtya sruyate- tasya priyaneva sira / nodo daksina paksa / pranoda utara paksa / ananda atna / brahna pucCan pratisWa (tE. 2.5) iti / tatra yadbrahna nantravarne prakrtan- satyan jnanananantan brahna iti, tadiha brahna pucCan pratisWa ityucyate / tadvijijnapayisayEvananayadaya anandanayaparyanta panca kosa kalpyante / tatra kuta prakrtahanaprakrtaprakriyaprasanga / nanvanandanayasyavayavatvena brahna pucCan pratisWa ityucyate, ananayadinaniva idan pucCan pratisWa ityadi / tatra kaTan brahnana svapraDanatvan sakyan vijnatun / prakrtatvaditi bruna / nanvanandanayavayavatvenapi brahnani vijnayanane na prakrtatvan hiyate, anandanayasya brahnatvaditi / atrocyate- taTa sati tadeva brahnanandanaya atnavayavi tadeva ca brahnapucCan pratisWavayava ityasananjasyan syat / anyataraparigrahe tu yuktan brahna pucCan pratisWa ityatrEva brahnanirdesa asrayitun, brahnasabdasanyogat / nanandanayavakye brahnasabdasanyogaBavaditi / apica brahna pucCan pratisWa ityuktatvedanucyate- tadapyesa sloko Bavati / asaneva sa Bavati / asadbrahneti veda cet / as

anantanayaparyanta panca kosa kalpyante / tatra kuta prakrtahanaprakrtaprakriyaprasanka / nanvanantanayasyavayavatvena prahna pucan pratista ityucyate, ananayatinaniva itan pucan pratista ityati / tatra katan prahnana svapratanatvan sakyan vicnatun / prakrtatvatiti pruna / nanvanantanayavayavatvenapi prahnani vicnayanane na prakrtatvan hiyate, anantanayasya prahnatvatiti / atrocyate- tata sati tateva prahnanantanaya atnavayavi tateva ca prahnapucan pratistavayava ityasanancasyan syat / anyataraparikrahe tu yuktan prahna pucan pratista ityatrEva prahnanirtesa asrayitun, prahnasaptasanyokat / pk: kaWavalisu paWyate- yasya brahna ca ksatran coBe Bavata odana / nrtyuryasyopasevanan ka itya veda yatra sa (1.2.24) iti / atra kascidodanopasecanasucito ta pratiyate / tatra kinagnirata syat, uta jiva, aTava paranatneti sansaya / visesanavaDaranat / trayanan cagnijivaparanatnananasningranTe prasnopanyasopalabDe / kin tavatpraptan / agnirateti / kuta, agniranada (br. 1.4.6) iti srutiprasidDiByan / jivo vata syat, tayoranya pipalan svadvati iti darsanat / na paranatna, anasnananyo aBicakasiti (nunqa. 3.1.1) iti darsanadityevan prapte bruna- atatra paranatna Bavitunarhati / kuta, caracaragrahanat / caracaran hi sTavarajanganan nrtyupasecananihadyatvena pratiyate, tadrsasya cadyasya na paranatnano nya kartsyenata sanBavati / paranatna tu vikarajatan sanharansarvanatityupapadyate / nanviha caracaragrahanan nopalaByate, kaTan sidDavacaracaragrahanan hetutvenopadiyate / nEsa dosa / nrtyupasecanatvena sarvasya praninikayasya pratiyananatvat, brahnaksatrayosca praDanyatpradarsanarTatvopapate / yatu paranatnano pi natrtvan sanBavati, anasnananyo aBicakasiti iti darsanaditi / atrocyate- karnaPalaBogasyapratiseDakanetadarsanan, tasya sanihitatvat / na vikarasanharasya pratiseDakan, sarvavedantesu srswisTitisanharakaranatvena brahnana prasidDatvat / tasnatparanatnatnEvehata Bavitunarhati / 9 / Pn: yasya paranatnano brahna ksatran coBe jati prasidDanavadodanO Bavata, yasya nrtyu sarvanaraka sanupasecananodananisraGrvatisWati, yatra so ta karanatna vartate, tan nirvisesanatnanan navirato duscaritat iti nantroktopayavanyaTa veda itTa itTananyastadrahito na vedetyarTa / pradarsananupalaksanan / naca brahksatre evatra vivaksite, nrtyupasecanena pranaBrnatropasTapanat / pranisu praDanatvena ca brahnaksatropanyasasyopapate / prakaranac ca
ck: katavalisu patyate- yasya prahna ca ksatran cope pavata otana / nrtyuryasyopasevanan ka itya veta yatra sa (1.2.24) iti / atra kascitotanopasecanasucito ta pratiyate / tatra kinaknirata syat, uta civa, atava paranatneti sansaya / visesanavataranat / trayanan caknicivaparanatnananasninkrante prasnopanyasopalapte / kin tavatpraptan / aknirateti / kuta, akniranata (pr. 1.4.6) iti srutiprasitipyan / civo vata syat, tayoranya pipalan svatvati iti tarsanat / na paranatna, anasnananyo apicakasiti (nunta. 3.1.1) iti tarsanatityevan prapte pruna- atatra paranatna pavitunarhati / kuta, caracarakrahanat / caracaran hi stavaracankanan nrtyupasecananihatyatvena pratiyate, tatrsasya catyasya na paranatnano nya kartsyenata sanpavati / paranatna tu vikaracatan sanharansarvanatityupapatyate / nanviha caracarakrahanan nopalapyate, katan sitavacaracarakrahanan hetutvenopatiyate / nEsa tosa / nrtyupasecanatvena sarvasya praninikayasya pratiyananatvat, prahnaksatrayosca pratanyatpratarsanartatvopapate / yatu paranatnano pi natrtvan sanpavati, anasnananyo apicakasiti iti tarsanatiti / atrocyate- karnapalapokasyapratisetakanetatarsanan, tasya sanihitatvat / na vikarasanharasya pratisetakan, sarvavetantesu srstistitisanharakaranatvena prahnana prasitatvat / tasnatparanatnatnEvehata pavitunarhati / 9 / pn: yasya paranatnano prahna ksatran cope cati prasitanavatotanO pavata, yasya nrtyu sarvanaraka sanupasecananotananisrakrvatistati, yatra so ta karanatna vartate, tan nirvisesanatnanan navirato tuscaritat iti nantroktopayavanyata veta ita itananyastatrahito na vetetyarta / pratarsananupalaksanan / naca prahksatre evatra vivaksite, nrtyupasecanena pranaprnatropastapanat / pranisu pratanatvena ca prahnaksatropanyasasyopapate / prakaranac ca

ck: tahara paranesvara utarepyo hetupya ityuktan / ta evotare hetava itanin prapancyante / itasca paranesvara eva tahara, yasnataharavakyasese paranesvarasyEva pratipatakO katisaptO pavata- ina sarva praca aharaharkacantya etan prahnalokan na vintanti (ca. 8.3.2) iti / tatra prakrtan taharan prahnalokasaptenapitaya tatvisaya kati pracasaptavacyanan civananapitiyanana taharasya prahnatan kanayati / tata hyaharaharcivanan susuptavastayan prahnavisayan kananan trstan srutyantare- sata sonya tata sanpano pavati (ca. 6.8.1) ityevanatO / loke pi kila katan susuptanacaksate prahniputo prahnatan kata iti / tata prahnalokasapto pi prakrte tahare prayucyanano civaputakasasankan nivartayanprahnatanasya kanayati / nanu kanalasanalokanapi prahnalokasapto kanayet / kanayetyati prahnano loka iti sastisanasavrtya vyutpatyeta / sananatikaranavrtya tu vyutpatyanano prahnEva loko prahnaloka iti paraneva prahna kanayisyati / etateva cahararprahnalokakananan trstan prahnasaptasya sananatikaranyavrtiparikrahe linkan / nahyaharaharina praca karyaprahnalokan satyalokakyan kacantiti sakyan kalpayitun / 15 / trtes ca nahino syasnin upalapte

pk: pratipaditan brahnano laksanan / pratipaditan ca brahnavisayan gatisananyan vedantavakyanan / pratipaditan ca praDanasyasabdatvan / tatredanaparanasankate- na janadikaranatvan brahnano brahnavisayan va gatisananyan vedantavakyanan pratipatun sakyan / kasnat / viganadarsanat / prativedantan hyanyanya srswirupalaByate kranadivEcitryat / taTahi- kvacit atnana akasa sanButa (tE. 2.1) ityakasadikasrswaranayate / kvacitejadika- tatejo srjata (Ca. 6.2.3) iti / kvacitpranadika- sa prananasrjata pranacCradDan (pra. 6.4) iti kvacidakranenEva lokananutpatiranayate- sa inanlokanasrjata / anBo naricirnaranapa (E. u. 4.2.1) iti / taTa kvacidasatpurvika srswi paWyate- asadva idanagra asitato vE sadajayata (tE. 2.7) iti / asadevedanagra asitatsadasitatsanaBavat (Ca. 3.19.1) iti ca / kvacidasadvadanirakaranena satpurvika prakriya pratijnayate- tadDEka ahurasadevedanagra asit ityupakranya kutastu Kalu sonyEvan syaditi hovaca kaTanasata sajayeteti satveva sonyedanagra asit (Ca. 6.2.1,2) iti / kvacitsvayankartrkEva vyakriya jagato nigadyate- tadDedan tarhyavyakrtanasitananarupaByaneva vyakriyata (br. 1.4.7) iti / evananekaDa vipratipatirvastuni ca vikalpasyanupapaterna vedantavakyanan jagatkaranavaDaranaparata nyaya / snrtinyayaprasidDayan tu karanantaraparigraho nyaya iti / evan prapte bruna - satyapi prativedantan srjyananesvakasadisu kranadidvarake vigane na sraswari kincidvigananasti / kuta / yaTa vyapadiswokte / yaTaButo hyekasninvedante sarvajna sarvesvara sarvatnEko dvitiya karanatvena vyapadiswastaTaButa eva vedantantaresvapi vyapadisyate / tadyaTa- satyan jnanananantan brahna (tE.2.1) iti / atra tavajnanasabdena parena ca tadvisayena kanayitrtvavacanena cetanan brahna nyarupayadaparaprayojyatvenesvaran karananabravit / tadvisayenEva parenatnasabdena sariradikosaparanparaya cantaranupravesanena sarvesananta pratyagatnanan niraDarayat / bahu sya prajayeya(tE. 2.6) iti catnavisayena bahuBavananusansanena srjyanananan vikaranan sraswuraBedanaBasata / taTa idan sarvanasrjata yadidan kinca (tE.2.6) iti sanastajagatsrswinirdesena praKsrsweradvitiyan sraswaranacaswe / tadatra yalaksanan brahna karanatvena vijnatan talaksananevanyatrapi vijnayate- sadeva senyedanagra asidekanevadvitiyan tadEksata bahu syan prajayeyeti / tatejo srjata (Ca. 6.2.1,3) iti / taTa atna va idaneka evagra asinanyakincana nisat / sa iksata lokanu srjE (E.u. 4.1.1,2) iti ca / evanjatiyakasya karanasvarupanirupanaparasya vakyajatasya prativedantanavigitarTatvat / karyavisayan tu viganan drsyate kvacidak
ck: pratipatitan prahnano laksanan / pratipatitan ca prahnavisayan katisananyan vetantavakyanan / pratipatitan ca pratanasyasaptatvan / tatretanaparanasankate- na canatikaranatvan prahnano prahnavisayan va katisananyan vetantavakyanan pratipatun sakyan / kasnat / vikanatarsanat / prativetantan hyanyanya srstirupalapyate kranativEcitryat / tatahi- kvacit atnana akasa sanputa (tE. 2.1) ityakasatikasrstaranayate / kvacitecatika- tateco srcata (ca. 6.2.3) iti / kvacitpranatika- sa prananasrcata pranacratan (pra. 6.4) iti kvacitakranenEva lokananutpatiranayate- sa inanlokanasrcata / anpo naricirnaranapa (E. u. 4.2.1) iti / tata kvacitasatpurvika srsti patyate- asatva itanakra asitato vE satacayata (tE. 2.7) iti / asatevetanakra asitatsatasitatsanapavat (ca. 3.19.1) iti ca / kvacitasatvatanirakaranena satpurvika prakriya praticnayate- tatEka ahurasatevetanakra asit ityupakranya kutastu kalu sonyEvan syatiti hovaca katanasata sacayeteti satveva sonyetanakra asit (ca. 6.2.1,2) iti / kvacitsvayankartrkEva vyakriya cakato nikatyate- tatetan tarhyavyakrtanasitananarupapyaneva vyakriyata (pr. 1.4.7) iti / evananekata vipratipatirvastuni ca vikalpasyanupapaterna vetantavakyanan cakatkaranavataranaparata nyaya / snrtinyayaprasitayan tu karanantaraparikraho nyaya iti / evan prapte pruna - satyapi prativetantan srcyananesvakasatisu kranatitvarake vikane na srastari kincitvikananasti / kuta / yata vyapatistokte / yataputo hyekasninvetante sarvacna sarvesvara sarvatnEko tvitiya karanatvena vyapatistastataputa eva vetantantaresvapi vyapatisyate / tatyata- satyan cnanananantan prahna (tE.2.1) iti / atra tavacnanasaptena parena ca tatvisayena kanayitrtvavacanena cetanan prahna nyarupayataparaprayocyatvenesvaran karananapravit / tatvisayenEva parenatnasaptena sariratikosaparanparaya cantaranupravesanena sarvesananta pratyakatnanan niratarayat / pahu sya pracayeya(tE. 2.6) iti catnavisayena pahupavananusansanena srcyanananan vikaranan srasturapetanapasata / tata itan sarvanasrcata yatitan kinca (tE.2.6) iti sanastacakatsrstinirtesena praksrsteratvitiyan srastaranacaste / tatatra yalaksanan prahna karanatvena vicnatan talaksananevanyatrapi vicnayate- sateva senyetanakra asitekanevatvitiyan tatEksata pahu syan pracayeyeti / tateco srcata (ca. 6.2.1,3) iti / tata atna va itaneka evakra asinanyakincana nisat / sa iksata lokanu srcE (E.u. 4.1.1,2) iti ca / evancatiyakasya karanasvarupanirupanaparasya vakyacatasya prativetantanavikitartatvat / karyavisayan tu vikanan trsyate kvacitakasati
s: प्रतिपादितं ब्रह्मणो लक्षणम् / प्रतिपादितं च ब्रह्मविषयं गतिसामान्यं वेदान्तवाक्यानाम् / प्रतिपादितं च प्रधानस्याशब्दत्वम् / तत्रेदमपरमाशङ्क

pk: cetananekanadvitiyan brahna ksiradivadevadivacanapeksya bahyasaDanan svayan parinanananan jagata karananiti sTitan / sastrarTaparisudDaye tu punaraksipati / krtsnaprasakti krtsnasya brahnana karyarupena parinana prapnoti, niravayavatvat / yadi brahna paTivyadivatsavayavanaBavisyatato syEkadesa paryanansyadekadesascavasTasyat / niravayavan tu brahna srutiByo vaganyate- niskalan niskriyan santan niravadyan niranjanan (sve. 6.19), divyo hyanurta purusa sabahyaByantarohyaja (nu. 2.1.2), idan nahadButananantanaparan vijnanaGana eva (br. 2.4.12), sa esa neti netyatna (br. 3.9.26), asTulanananu (br. 3.8.8) ityadyaBya sarvavisesapratiseDiniBya / tatascEkadesaparinanasanBavatkrtsnaparinanaprasaktO satyan nulocCeda prasajyeta / draswavyatopadesanarTakyan capananayatnadraswatvatkaryasya, tadvyatiriktasya ca brahnano sanBavat ajatvadisabdakopasca / aTEtadosaparijihirsaya savayavaneva brahnaByupaganyeta taTapi ye niravayavatvasya pratipadaka sabda udahrtaste prakusyeyu / savayavatve canityatvaprasanga iti / sarvaTayan pakso na Gawayitun sakyata ityaksipati / 26 / Pn: paryanansyat parinato Bavisyat / ekadesascavasTasyadaparinato Bavisyat / srutes tu sabdanulatvat
ck: cetananekanatvitiyan prahna ksirativatevativacanapeksya pahyasatanan svayan parinanananan cakata karananiti stitan / sastrartaparisutaye tu punaraksipati / krtsnaprasakti krtsnasya prahnana karyarupena parinana prapnoti, niravayavatvat / yati prahna pativyativatsavayavanapavisyatato syEkatesa paryanansyatekatesascavastasyat / niravayavan tu prahna srutipyo vakanyate- niskalan niskriyan santan niravatyan nirancanan (sve. 6.19), tivyo hyanurta purusa sapahyapyantarohyaca (nu. 2.1.2), itan nahatputananantanaparan vicnanakana eva (pr. 2.4.12), sa esa neti netyatna (pr. 3.9.26), astulanananu (pr. 3.8.8) ityatyapya sarvavisesapratisetinipya / tatascEkatesaparinanasanpavatkrtsnaparinanaprasaktO satyan nuloceta prasacyeta / trastavyatopatesanartakyan capananayatnatrastatvatkaryasya, tatvyatiriktasya ca prahnano sanpavat acatvatisaptakopasca / atEtatosaparicihirsaya savayavaneva prahnapyupakanyeta tatapi ye niravayavatvasya pratipataka sapta utahrtaste prakusyeyu / savayavatve canityatvaprasanka iti / sarvatayan pakso na katayitun sakyata ityaksipati / 26 / pn: paryanansyat parinato pavisyat / ekatesascavastasyataparinato pavisyat / srutes tu saptanulatvat
s: चेतनमेकमद्वितीयं ब्रह्म क्षीरादिवद्देवादिवच्चानपेक्ष्य बाह्यसाधनं स्वयं परिणममानं जगतः कारणमिति स्थितम् / शास्त्रार्थपरिशुद्धये तु पुनराक्षि

pk: tusabdenaksepan pariharati / na Kalvasnatpakse kascidapi doso sti / na tavatkrtsnaprasaktirasti / kuta / srute / yaTEva hi brahnano jagadutpati sruyata evan vikaravyatirekenapi brahnano vastanan sruyate, prakrtivikarayorBedena vyapadesat seyan devatEksata hantahaninastisro devata anena jivenatnananupravisya nanarupe vyakaravani (Ca. 6.3.2) iti, tavanasya nahina tato jyayansca purusa / pado sya sarva Butani tripadasyanrtan divi (Ca. 3.12.6) iti cEvanjatiyakat / taTa hrdayayatanatvavacanatsatsanpativacanaca / yadi ca krtsnan brahna karyaBavenopayuktan syat sata sonya tada sanpano Bavati (Ca. 6.81) iti susuptigatan visesanananupapanan syat / vikrtena brahnana nityasanpanatvadivikrtasya ca brahnano Bavat / taTendriyagocaratvapratiseDadbrahnano vikarasya cendriyagocaratvopapate / tasnadastyavikrtan brahna / naca niravayavatvasabdakopo sti, sruyananatvadeva niravayavatvasyapyaByupaganyananatvat / sabdanulan ca brahna sabdaprananakan nendriyadiprananakan tadyaTasabdanaByupagantavyan / sabdascoBayanapi brahnana pratipadayatyakrtsnaprasaktin niravayavatvan ca / lOkikananapi naninantrOsaDipraBrtinan desakalaninitavEcitryavasacCaktayo virudDanekakaryavisaya drsyante / ta api tavanopadesanantarena kevalena tarkenavagantun sakyante sya vastuna etavatya etatsahaya etadvisaya etatprayojanasca saktaya iti / kinutacintyasvaBavasya brahnano rupan vina sabdena na nirupyeta / taTacahu pOranika - acintya Kalu ye Bava na tanstarkena yojayet / prakrtiBya paran yaca tadacintyasya laksanan / iti tasnacCabdanula evatindriyarTayaTatnyaDigana / nanu sabdenapi na sakyate virudDorTa pratyayayitun niravayavan ca brahna parinanate naca krtsnaniti / yadi niravayavan brahna syanEva parinaneta / krtsnaneva va parinaneta / aTa kenacidrupena parinaneta kenacicavatisWeteti rupaBedakalpanatsavayavaneva prasajyeta / kriyavisaye hi atiratre soqasinan grhnati natiratre soqasinan grhnati ityevanjatiyakayan viroDapratitavapi vikalpasrayanan viroDapariharakaranan Bavati purusatantratvacanusWanasya / iha tu vikalpasrayanenapi na viroDaparihara sanBavatyapurusatantratvadvastuna tasnadurGawanetaditi / nEsa dosa / avidyakalpitarupaBedaByupaganat / nahyavidyakalpitena rupaBedena savayavan vastu sanpadyate / nahi tiniropahatanayanenaneka iva candrana drsyanano neka eva Bavati / avidyakalpitena ca nanarupalaksanena rupaBedena vyakrtavyakrtatnakena tatvanyatvaByananirvacaniyena brahna parinanadisarvavyavaharaspadatvan pratipadyate / paranarTikena ca rupena sarvavyavaharatitanaparinanatavatisWate / vacaranBan
ck: tusaptenaksepan pariharati / na kalvasnatpakse kascitapi toso sti / na tavatkrtsnaprasaktirasti / kuta / srute / yatEva hi prahnano cakatutpati sruyata evan vikaravyatirekenapi prahnano vastanan sruyate, prakrtivikarayorpetena vyapatesat seyan tevatEksata hantahaninastisro tevata anena civenatnananupravisya nanarupe vyakaravani (ca. 6.3.2) iti, tavanasya nahina tato cyayansca purusa / pato sya sarva putani tripatasyanrtan tivi (ca. 3.12.6) iti cEvancatiyakat / tata hrtayayatanatvavacanatsatsanpativacanaca / yati ca krtsnan prahna karyapavenopayuktan syat sata sonya tata sanpano pavati (ca. 6.81) iti susuptikatan visesanananupapanan syat / vikrtena prahnana nityasanpanatvativikrtasya ca prahnano pavat / tatentriyakocaratvapratisetatprahnano vikarasya centriyakocaratvopapate / tasnatastyavikrtan prahna / naca niravayavatvasaptakopo sti, sruyananatvateva niravayavatvasyapyapyupakanyananatvat / saptanulan ca prahna saptaprananakan nentriyatiprananakan tatyatasaptanapyupakantavyan / saptascopayanapi prahnana pratipatayatyakrtsnaprasaktin niravayavatvan ca / lOkikananapi naninantrOsatipraprtinan tesakalaninitavEcitryavasacaktayo virutanekakaryavisaya trsyante / ta api tavanopatesanantarena kevalena tarkenavakantun sakyante sya vastuna etavatya etatsahaya etatvisaya etatprayocanasca saktaya iti / kinutacintyasvapavasya prahnano rupan vina saptena na nirupyeta / tatacahu pOranika - acintya kalu ye pava na tanstarkena yocayet / prakrtipya paran yaca tatacintyasya laksanan / iti tasnacaptanula evatintriyartayatatnyatikana / nanu saptenapi na sakyate virutorta pratyayayitun niravayavan ca prahna parinanate naca krtsnaniti / yati niravayavan prahna syanEva parinaneta / krtsnaneva va parinaneta / ata kenacitrupena parinaneta kenacicavatisteteti rupapetakalpanatsavayavaneva prasacyeta / kriyavisaye hi atiratre sotasinan krhnati natiratre sotasinan krhnati ityevancatiyakayan virotapratitavapi vikalpasrayanan virotapariharakaranan pavati purusatantratvacanustanasya / iha tu vikalpasrayanenapi na virotaparihara sanpavatyapurusatantratvatvastuna tasnaturkatanetatiti / nEsa tosa / avityakalpitarupapetapyupakanat / nahyavityakalpitena rupapetena savayavan vastu sanpatyate / nahi tiniropahatanayanenaneka iva cantrana trsyanano neka eva pavati / avityakalpitena ca nanarupalaksanena rupapetena vyakrtavyakrtatnakena tatvanyatvapyananirvacaniyena prahna parinanatisarvavyavaharaspatatvan pratipatyate / paranartikena ca rupena sarvavyavaharatitanaparinanatavatistate / vacaranpananat
s: तुशब्देनाक्षेपं परिहरति / न खल्वस्मत्पक्षे कश्चिदपि दोषो ऽस्ति / न तावत्कृत्स्नप्रसक्तिरस्ति / कुतः / श्रुतेः / यथैव हि ब्रह्मणो जगदुत्पत्ति

pk: paresanapyesa sanana svapakse dosa / praDanavadino pi hi niravayavanaparicCinan sabdadihinan praDanan savavasya paricCinasya sabdadinata karyasya karananiti svapaksa / tatrapi krtsnaprasaktirniravayavatvatpraDanasya prapnoti niravayavatvaByupaganakopo va / nanu nEva tErniravayavan praDananaByupaganyate, satvarajastanansi trayo guna nityastesan sanyavasTa praDane tErevavayavEstatsavayavaniti / nEvanjatiyakena savayavatvena prakrto dosa parihartun paryate / yata satvarajastanasanapyekEkasya sananan niravayavatvan / ekEkaneva cetaradvayanugrhitan sajatiyasya prapancasyopadananiti sananatvatsvapaksadosaprasangasya / tarkapratisWanatsavayavatvaneveti cet / evavanapyanityatvadidosaprasanga / aTa saktaya eva karyavEcitryasucita avayava ityaBipraya / tastu brahnavadino pyavasiswa / taTanuvadino pyanuranvantarena sanyujyanano niravayavatvadyadi kartsyena sanyujyeta tata praTinanupapateranunatratvaprasanga / aTEkadesena sanyujyeta taTapi niravayavatvaByupaganakopa iti svapakse pi sanana esa dosa / sananatvaca nanyanyatarasnineva paksa upakseptavyo Bavati / parihrtastu brahnavadina svapakse dosa / 29 / Pn: vEsesikanan hyanuByan sanyujya hyanukanekanaraByate, tEstriBirhyanukEstryanukanekanaraByata iti prakriya / 10 sarvopetaDikaranan / su. 30-31 sarvopeta ca tadarsanat
ck: paresanapyesa sanana svapakse tosa / pratanavatino pi hi niravayavanaparicinan saptatihinan pratanan savavasya paricinasya saptatinata karyasya karananiti svapaksa / tatrapi krtsnaprasaktirniravayavatvatpratanasya prapnoti niravayavatvapyupakanakopo va / nanu nEva tErniravayavan pratananapyupakanyate, satvaracastanansi trayo kuna nityastesan sanyavasta pratane tErevavayavEstatsavayavaniti / nEvancatiyakena savayavatvena prakrto tosa parihartun paryate / yata satvaracastanasanapyekEkasya sananan niravayavatvan / ekEkaneva cetaratvayanukrhitan sacatiyasya prapancasyopatananiti sananatvatsvapaksatosaprasankasya / tarkapratistanatsavayavatvaneveti cet / evavanapyanityatvatitosaprasanka / ata saktaya eva karyavEcitryasucita avayava ityapipraya / tastu prahnavatino pyavasista / tatanuvatino pyanuranvantarena sanyucyanano niravayavatvatyati kartsyena sanyucyeta tata pratinanupapateranunatratvaprasanka / atEkatesena sanyucyeta tatapi niravayavatvapyupakanakopa iti svapakse pi sanana esa tosa / sananatvaca nanyanyatarasnineva paksa upakseptavyo pavati / parihrtastu prahnavatina svapakse tosa / 29 / pn: vEsesikanan hyanupyan sanyucya hyanukanekanarapyate, tEstripirhyanukEstryanukanekanarapyata iti prakriya / 10 sarvopetatikaranan / su. 30-31 sarvopeta ca tatarsanat
s: परेषामप्येष समानः स्वपक्षे दोषः / प्रधानवादिनो ऽपि हि निरवयवमपरिच्छिन्नं शब्दादिहीनं प्रधानं साववस्य परिच्छिन्नस्य शब्दादिमतः कार्यस्य कारणम

pk: ekasyapi brahnano vicitrasaktiyogadupapadyate vicitro vikaraprapanca ityuktan / tatpuna kaTanavaganyate paran brahneti / taducyate / sarvopeta ca tadarsanat / sarvasaktiyukta ca para devatetyaByupagantavyan / kuta / tadarsanat / yaTahi darsayati sruti sarvasaktiyogan parasya devataya - sarvakarna sarvakana sarvaganDa sarvarasa sarvanidanaByato vakyanadara (Ca. 3.14.4), satyakana satyasankalpa (Ca. 8.7.1), ya sarvajna sarvavit (nunqa. 1.1.9), etasya va aksarasya prasasane gargisuryacandranasO viDrtO tisWata (br. 3.8.9) ityevanjatiyaka / 30 / Pn: aByata aBitovyapta / avaki vagindriyasunya / anadaro niskana / vikaranatvan neti cet tad uktan
ck: ekasyapi prahnano vicitrasaktiyokatupapatyate vicitro vikaraprapanca ityuktan / tatpuna katanavakanyate paran prahneti / tatucyate / sarvopeta ca tatarsanat / sarvasaktiyukta ca para tevatetyapyupakantavyan / kuta / tatarsanat / yatahi tarsayati sruti sarvasaktiyokan parasya tevataya - sarvakarna sarvakana sarvakanta sarvarasa sarvanitanapyato vakyanatara (ca. 3.14.4), satyakana satyasankalpa (ca. 8.7.1), ya sarvacna sarvavit (nunta. 1.1.9), etasya va aksarasya prasasane karkisuryacantranasO vitrtO tistata (pr. 3.8.9) ityevancatiyaka / 30 / pn: apyata apitovyapta / avaki vakintriyasunya / anataro niskana / vikaranatvan neti cet tat uktan
s: एकस्यापि ब्रह्मणो विचित्रशक्तियोगादुपपद्यते विचित्रो विकारप्रपञ्च इत्युक्तम् / तत्पुनः कथमवगम्यते परं ब्रह्मेति / तदुच्यते / सर्वोपेता च तद्

pk: syadetat vikaranan paran devatan sasti sastran- acaksuskanasrotranavaganana (br.3.8.8) ityevanjatiyakan / kaTan sa sarvasaktiyuktapi sati karyaya praBavet / devadayo hi cetana sarvasaktiyukta api santa aDyatnikakaryakaranasanpana eva tasnEtasnE karyaya praBavanto vijnayante / kaTanca neti neti (br. 3.9.23) iti pratisidDasarvavisesaya devataya sarvasaktiyoga sanBavediti cet / yadatra vaktavyan tatpurastadevoktan / sratyavagahyanevedanatiganBiran brahna na tarkavagahyan / naca yaTEkasya sanarTyan drswan taTanyasyapi sanarTyena Bavitavyaniti niyano stiti / pratisidDasarvavisesasyapi brahnana sarvasaktiyoga sanBavatityetadapyavidyakalpitarupaBedopanyasenoktaneva / taTaca sastran- apanipado javano grahita pasyatyacaksu sa srnotyakarna (svan. 3.19) ityakaranasyapi brahnana sarvasanarTyayogan darsayati / 31 / 1 prayojanavatvaDikaranan. su. 32-3 na prayojanavatvat
ck: syatetat vikaranan paran tevatan sasti sastran- acaksuskanasrotranavakanana (pr.3.8.8) ityevancatiyakan / katan sa sarvasaktiyuktapi sati karyaya prapavet / tevatayo hi cetana sarvasaktiyukta api santa atyatnikakaryakaranasanpana eva tasnEtasnE karyaya prapavanto vicnayante / katanca neti neti (pr. 3.9.23) iti pratisitasarvavisesaya tevataya sarvasaktiyoka sanpavetiti cet / yatatra vaktavyan tatpurastatevoktan / sratyavakahyanevetanatikanpiran prahna na tarkavakahyan / naca yatEkasya sanartyan trstan tatanyasyapi sanartyena pavitavyaniti niyano stiti / pratisitasarvavisesasyapi prahnana sarvasaktiyoka sanpavatityetatapyavityakalpitarupapetopanyasenoktaneva / tataca sastran- apanipato cavano krahita pasyatyacaksu sa srnotyakarna (svan. 3.19) ityakaranasyapi prahnana sarvasanartyayokan tarsayati / 31 / 1 prayocanavatvatikaranan. su. 32-3 na prayocanavatvat
s: स्यादेतत् विकरणां परां देवतां शास्ति शास्त्रम्- ऽअचक्षुष्कमश्रोत्रमवागमनाःऽ (बृ.३.८.८) इत्येवञ्जातीयकम् / कथं सा सर्वशक्तियुक्तापि सती कार्य

pk: anyaTa punascetanakartrtvan jagata aksipati / na Kalu cetana paranatnedan jagadbinban viracayitunarhati / kuta / prayojanavatvatpravrtinan / cetano hi loke budDipurvakari purusa pravartanano na nandopakrananapi tavatpravrtinatnaprayojananupayoginanaraBanano drswa / kinuta gurutarasanranBan / Bavati ca lokaprasidDyanuvadini sruti- na va are sarvasya kanaya sarvan priyan Bavatyatnanastu kanaya sarvan priyan Bavati (br. 2.4.5) iti gurutarasanranBa ceyan pravrtiryaducavacaprapancan jagadbinban viracayitavyan / yadiyanapi pravrtiscetanasya paranatnana atnaprayojanopayogini parikalpyeta paritrptitvan paranatnana sruyananan baDyeta / prayojanaBave va pravrtyaBavo pi syat / aTa cetano pi sanunato budDyaparaDadantarenEvatnaprayojanan pravartanano drswastaTa paranatnapi pravartisyata ityucyeta / taTa sati sarvajnatvan paranatnana sruyananan baDyeta / tasnadasliswa cetanatsrswiriti / 32 / Pn: budDyaparaDo vivekaBava / lokavat tu lilakEvalyan
ck: anyata punascetanakartrtvan cakata aksipati / na kalu cetana paranatnetan cakatpinpan viracayitunarhati / kuta / prayocanavatvatpravrtinan / cetano hi loke putipurvakari purusa pravartanano na nantopakrananapi tavatpravrtinatnaprayocananupayokinanarapanano trsta / kinuta kurutarasanranpan / pavati ca lokaprasityanuvatini sruti- na va are sarvasya kanaya sarvan priyan pavatyatnanastu kanaya sarvan priyan pavati (pr. 2.4.5) iti kurutarasanranpa ceyan pravrtiryatucavacaprapancan cakatpinpan viracayitavyan / yatiyanapi pravrtiscetanasya paranatnana atnaprayocanopayokini parikalpyeta paritrptitvan paranatnana sruyananan patyeta / prayocanapave va pravrtyapavo pi syat / ata cetano pi sanunato putyaparatatantarenEvatnaprayocanan pravartanano trstastata paranatnapi pravartisyata ityucyeta / tata sati sarvacnatvan paranatnana sruyananan patyeta / tasnataslista cetanatsrstiriti / 32 / pn: putyaparato vivekapava / lokavat tu lilakEvalyan

ck: punasca cakacanatihetutvanisvarasyaksipyate stunanikanananyayena praticnatasyartasya trtikaranaya / nesvaro cakata karananupapatyate / kuta / vEsanyanErkrnyaprasankat / kanscitatyantasukapaca karoti tevatin, kanscitatyantatukapaca pasvatin, kanscinatyanapokapaco nanusyatinityevan visanan srstin nirninanasyEsvarasya prtakcanasyeva rakatvesopapate / srutisnrtyavataritasvacatvatisvarasvapavavilopa prasacyeta / tata kalacanErapi cukupsitan nirkrnatvanatikruratvan tukayokavitanatsarvapracopasanharaca prasacyeta / tasnatvEsanyanErkrnyaprasankanesvara karananityevan prapte pruna - vEsanyanErkrnye nesvarasya prasacyete / kasnat / sapeksatvat / yati hi nirapeksa kevala isvaro visanan srstin nirninite syatanetO tosO vEsanyan nErkrnyan ca / natu nirapeksasya nirnatrtvanasti / sapekso hisvaro visanan srstin nirninite / kinapeksata iti cet / tarnatarnavapeksata iti vatana / ata srcyananapranitarnatarnapeksa visana srstiriti nayanislavarasyaparata / isvarastu parcanyavatrastavya / yatahi parcanyo vrihiyavatisrstO sataranan karanan pavati, vrihiyavativEsanye tu tatatpicakatanyevasataranani sanartyani karanani pavanti, evanisvaro tevananusyatisrstO sataranan karanan ksavati / tevananusyativEsanye tu tatacivakatanyevasataranani karnani karanani pavantyevanisvara sapeksatvana vEsanyanErkrnyapyan tusyati / katan punaravakanyate sapeksa isvaro nicanatyanotanan sansaran nirninita iti / tatahi tarsayati sruti - esa hyeva satu karna karayati tan yanepyo lokepya uninisata esa u evasatu karna karayati tan yanato ninisate (kO.pra. 3.8) iti / punyo vE punyena karnana pavati papa papena (pr. 3.2.13) iti ca / snrtirapi pranikarnavisesapeksanevesvarasyanukrahitatvan ca tarsayati- ye yata nan prapatyante tanstatEva pacanyahan (pa.ki. 4.1) ityevancatiyaka / 34 / pn: prtakcana panara / yan canununinisate urtvan netunicati tan satu karayatyesa isvara ityanvaya / na karnavipakat iti cen nanatitvat

ck: yatyapitan vetantavakyananEtanparyan nirupayitun sastran pravrtan na tarksastravat tevalapir yuktipi kancit sitantan satayitun tusayitun va pravrtan / tatapi vetantavakyan api vyacaksanE sanyaktarsanapratipaksaputani sankyatitarsanani nirakaraniyaniti tatarta para pata pravartate / vetantartanirnayasya ca sanyaktarsanartatvat tanirnayena svapaksastapanan pratanan krtan tatyapyarhitan parapaksapratyakyanat iti / nanu nunuksunan noksasatanatvena sanyaktarsananirupanaya svapaksastapanan eva kevalan kartun yuktan kin parapaksanirakaranena paratvesakarena / patan evan / tatapi nahacanaparikrhitani nahanti sankyatitantrani sanyaktarsanapatesena pravrtanyupalapya pavet kesancin nantanatinan etany api sanyaktarsanayopateyanityapeksa / tata yuktakatatvasanpavena sarvacnapasitatvaca srata ca tesvityatastatasaratopapatanaya prayatyate / nanu iksaternasaptan (pra,su. 1.1.5), kanaca nanunanapeksa (pra,su. 1.1.18) etena sarve vyakyata vyakyata (pra,su. 1.4.28) iti ca purvatrapi sankyatipaksapratiksepa krta, kin puna krtakaraneneti / tatucyate- sankyataya svapaksastapanaya vetantavakyanyapyutahrtya svapaksanukunenEva yocayanto vyacaksate, tesan yatvyakyanan tatvyakyanapasan na sanyakvyakyananityetavatpurvan krtan / iha tu vakyanirapeksa svatantrastatyuktipratiseta kriyata ityesa visesa / tatra sankya nanyante- yata katasaravatayo peta nrtatnananviyanana nrtatnakasananyapurvaka loke trsta, tata sarva eva pahyatyatnika peta sukatukanohatnatayanviyanana sukatukanohatnakasananyapurvika pavitunarhanti / yatatsukatukanohatnakan sananyan tatrikunan pratanan nrtvatacetanan cetanasya purusartan satayitun svapavenEva vicitrena vikaratnana vivartata iti / tata parinanatipirapi linkEstateva pratanananuninute / tatra vatana - ck: syatetat / yata ksiranacetanan svapavenEva vatsavivrtyartan pravartate, yataca calanacetanan svapavenEva lokopakaraya syantata evan pratananacetanan svapavenEva purusartasitaye pravartisyata iti / nEtatsatucyate / yatastatrapi payonpunoscetanatistitayoreva pravrtirityanunininahe / upayavatiprasite ratatavacetane kevale pravrtyatarsanat / sastran ca yo psu tistan yo po ntaro yanayati (pr. 3.7.4), etasya va aksarasya prasasane karki pracyonya natya syantante (pr. 3.8.9) ityevancatiyakan sanastasya lokaparispantitasyesvaratistitatan sravayati / tasnatsatyapaksaniksiptatvatpayonpuvatityanupanyasa / cetanayasca tenva snehecaya payasa pravartakatvopapate / vatsacosanena ca payasa akrsyananatvat / nacanpuno pyatyantananapeksa, ninapunyatyapeksatvatsyantanasya / cetanapeksatvan tu sarvatropatarsitan / upasanharatarsananeti cena ksiravati (pra.su. 2.1.24) ityatra tu pahyaninitanirapeksanapi svasrayan karyan pavatityetalokatrstya nitarsitan / sastratrstya tu puna sarvatrEvesvarapeksatvanapatyananan na paranutyate / 3 / pn: satyavata paksena tulyatvat / anupanyasa na vicarapuni / vyatirekanavastites canapeksatvat

pk: sanKyanan trayo guna sanyenavatisWanana praDanan / natu tadvyatirekena praDanasya pravartakan nivartakan va kincidbahyanapeksyanavastitanasti / purusastudasino na pravartako na nivartaka ityato napeksan praDanan, anapeksatvaca kadacitpraDanan nahadadyakarena parinanate kadacina parinanata ityetadayuktan / isvarasya tu sarvajnatvatsarvasaktitvanahanayatvaca pravrtyapravrti na viruDyete / 4 / anyatraBavac ca na trnadivat
ck: sankyanan trayo kuna sanyenavatistanana pratanan / natu tatvyatirekena pratanasya pravartakan nivartakan va kincitpahyanapeksyanavastitanasti / purusastutasino na pravartako na nivartaka ityato napeksan pratanan, anapeksatvaca katacitpratanan nahatatyakarena parinanate katacina parinanata ityetatayuktan / isvarasya tu sarvacnatvatsarvasaktitvanahanayatvaca pravrtyapravrti na virutyete / 4 / anyatrapavac ca na trnativat
s: सांख्यानां त्रयो गुणाः साम्येनावतिष्ठमानाः प्रधानम् / नतु तद्व्यतिरेकेण प्रधानस्य प्रवर्तकं निवर्तकं वा किञ्चिद्बाह्यमपेक्ष्यमवस्तितमस्ति /

pk: syadetat / yaTa trnapalavodadi ninitantaranirapeksan svaBavadeva ksiradyakarena parinanata evan praDananapi nahadadyakarena parinansyata iti / kaTan ca ninitantaranirapeksan trnaditi ganyate / ninitantaranupalanBat / yadi hi kincininitanupalaBenahi tato yaTakanan tena trnadyupadaya ksiran sanpadayenahi, natu sanpadayanahe / tasnatsvaBavikastrnade parinanastaTa praDanasyapi syaditi / atrocyate- BavetrnadivatsvaBavika praDanasyapi paranano yadi trnaderapi svaBavika parinano Byupaganyeta / natvaByupaganyate, ninitantaropalabDe / kaTan ninitantaropalabDi, anyatraBavat / DenvEva hyupayuktan trnadi ksiro Bavati na prahinananaqudadyupayuktan va / yadi hi nirninitanetatsyadDenusarirasanbanDadanyatrapi trnadi ksiriBavet / naca yaTakanan nanusErna sakyan sanpadayitunityetavata nirninitan Bavati / Bavati hi kincitkaryan nanusasanpadyan kincidEvasanpadyan / nanusya api saknuvatyevocitenopayena trnadyupadaya ksiran sanpadayitun / praButan hi ksiran kanayanana praButan Gasan Denun carayanti / tatasca praButan ksiran laBante / tasnana trnadivatsvaBavika praDanasya parinana / 5 / Pn: prahinan naswan / aByupagane py arTaBavat
ck: syatetat / yata trnapalavotati ninitantaranirapeksan svapavateva ksiratyakarena parinanata evan pratananapi nahatatyakarena parinansyata iti / katan ca ninitantaranirapeksan trnatiti kanyate / ninitantaranupalanpat / yati hi kincininitanupalapenahi tato yatakanan tena trnatyupataya ksiran sanpatayenahi, natu sanpatayanahe / tasnatsvapavikastrnate parinanastata pratanasyapi syatiti / atrocyate- pavetrnativatsvapavika pratanasyapi paranano yati trnaterapi svapavika parinano pyupakanyeta / natvapyupakanyate, ninitantaropalapte / katan ninitantaropalapti, anyatrapavat / tenvEva hyupayuktan trnati ksiro pavati na prahinananatutatyupayuktan va / yati hi nirninitanetatsyatenusarirasanpantatanyatrapi trnati ksiripavet / naca yatakanan nanusErna sakyan sanpatayitunityetavata nirninitan pavati / pavati hi kincitkaryan nanusasanpatyan kincitEvasanpatyan / nanusya api saknuvatyevocitenopayena trnatyupataya ksiran sanpatayitun / praputan hi ksiran kanayanana praputan kasan tenun carayanti / tatasca praputan ksiran lapante / tasnana trnativatsvapavika pratanasya parinana / 5 / pn: prahinan nastan / apyupakane py artapavat
s: स्यादेतत् / यथा तृणपल्लवोदादि निमित्तान्तरनिरपेक्षं स्वभावादेव क्षीराद्याकारेण परिणमत एवं प्रधानमपि महदाद्याकारेण परिणंस्यत इति / कथं च निमि

pk: svaBaviki praDanapravrtirna Bavatiti sTapitan / aTapi nana Bavata sradDananuruDyanana svaBavikineva praDanasya pravrtinaByupagacCena taTapi doso nusajyetEva / kuta / arTaBavat / yadi tavatsvaBaviki praDanasya pravrtirna kincidanyadihapeksata ityucyeta tato yaTEva sahakari kincinapeksata evan prayojananapi kincinapeksisyate ityata praDanan purusasyarTan saDayitun pravartata itiyan pratijna hiyeta / sa yadi bruyatsahakaryeva kevalan napeksate na prayojananapiti / taTapi praDanapravrte prayojanan vivektavyan Bogo va syadapavargo voBayan veti / Bogascetkidrso naDeyatisayasya purusasya Bogo Bavet / anirnoksaprasangasca apavargascetpragapi pravrterapavargasya sidDatvatpravrtiranarTika syat / sabdadyanupalabDiprasangasca / uBayarTataByupagane pi Boktavyanan praDananatranananantyadanirnoksaprasanga eva / nacOtsukyanivrtyarTa pravrti / nahi praDanasyacetanasyOtsukyan sanBavati / naca purasasya nirnalasya niskalasyOtsukyan / drksaktisargasaktivEyarTyaBayacetpravrtistarhi drksaktyanucCedavatsargasaktyanucCedatsansaranucCedadanirnoksaprasanga eva / tasnatpraDanasya purusarTa pravrtirityetadayuktan / 6 / Pn: arTaBavat purusarTaBavaprasangat / suKaduKa praptiparihararupatisayasunyasya / niyante Bujyante iti natra Boga / purusasnavad iti cet taTapi
ck: svapaviki pratanapravrtirna pavatiti stapitan / atapi nana pavata sratananurutyanana svapavikineva pratanasya pravrtinapyupakacena tatapi toso nusacyetEva / kuta / artapavat / yati tavatsvapaviki pratanasya pravrtirna kincitanyatihapeksata ityucyeta tato yatEva sahakari kincinapeksata evan prayocananapi kincinapeksisyate ityata pratanan purusasyartan satayitun pravartata itiyan praticna hiyeta / sa yati pruyatsahakaryeva kevalan napeksate na prayocananapiti / tatapi pratanapravrte prayocanan vivektavyan poko va syatapavarko vopayan veti / pokascetkitrso nateyatisayasya purusasya poko pavet / anirnoksaprasankasca apavarkascetprakapi pravrterapavarkasya sitatvatpravrtiranartika syat / saptatyanupalaptiprasankasca / upayartatapyupakane pi poktavyanan pratananatranananantyatanirnoksaprasanka eva / nacOtsukyanivrtyarta pravrti / nahi pratanasyacetanasyOtsukyan sanpavati / naca purasasya nirnalasya niskalasyOtsukyan / trksaktisarkasaktivEyartyapayacetpravrtistarhi trksaktyanucetavatsarkasaktyanucetatsansaranucetatanirnoksaprasanka eva / tasnatpratanasya purusarta pravrtirityetatayuktan / 6 / pn: artapavat purusartapavaprasankat / sukatuka praptiparihararupatisayasunyasya / niyante pucyante iti natra poka / purusasnavat iti cet tatapi
s: स्वाभाविकी प्रधानप्रवृत्तिर्न भवतीति स्थापितम् / अथापि नाम भवतः श्रद्धामनुरुध्यमानाः स्वाभाविकीमेव प्रधानस्य प्रवृत्तिमभ्युपगच्छेम तथापि दोष

pk: syadetat / yaTa kascitpuruso drksaktisanpana pravrtisaktihina panguraparan purusan pravrtisaktisanpanan drksaktihinananDanaDisWaya pravartayati / yaTa vayaskanto sna svayanapravartanano pyaya pravartayati / evan purusa praDanan pravartayisyatiti drswantapratyayena puna pratyavasTanan / atrocyate- taTapi nEva dosanirnokso sti / aByupetahanan tavadosa apatati / praDanasya svatantrasya pravrtyaByupaganat, purusasya na pravartakatvanaByupaganat / kaTan codasina purusa praDanan pravartayet / pangurapi hyanDan vagadiBi purusan pravartayati / nEvan purusasya kascidapi pravartanavyaparo sti, niskriyatvaca / napyayaskantavatsaniDinatrena pravartayet / saniDinityatvena pravrtinityatvaprasangat / ayaskantasya tvanityasaniDerasti svavyapara saniDi, parinarjanadyapeksa casyastityanupanyasa purusasnavaditi / taTa praDanasyacEtanyatpurusasya cOdasinyatrtiyasya ca tayo sanbanDayituraBavatsanbanDanupapati / yogyataninite ca sanbanDe yogyatanucCedadanirnoksaprasanga / purvavacehapyarTaBavo vikalpayitavya / paranatnanastu svarupavyapasrayanOdasinyan nayavyapasrayan ca pravartakatvanityastyatisaya / 7 / angitvanupapates ca
ck: syatetat / yata kascitpuruso trksaktisanpana pravrtisaktihina pankuraparan purusan pravrtisaktisanpanan trksaktihinanantanatistaya pravartayati / yata vayaskanto sna svayanapravartanano pyaya pravartayati / evan purusa pratanan pravartayisyatiti trstantapratyayena puna pratyavastanan / atrocyate- tatapi nEva tosanirnokso sti / apyupetahanan tavatosa apatati / pratanasya svatantrasya pravrtyapyupakanat, purusasya na pravartakatvanapyupakanat / katan cotasina purusa pratanan pravartayet / pankurapi hyantan vakatipi purusan pravartayati / nEvan purusasya kascitapi pravartanavyaparo sti, niskriyatvaca / napyayaskantavatsanitinatrena pravartayet / sanitinityatvena pravrtinityatvaprasankat / ayaskantasya tvanityasaniterasti svavyapara saniti, parinarcanatyapeksa casyastityanupanyasa purusasnavatiti / tata pratanasyacEtanyatpurusasya cOtasinyatrtiyasya ca tayo sanpantayiturapavatsanpantanupapati / yokyataninite ca sanpante yokyatanucetatanirnoksaprasanka / purvavacehapyartapavo vikalpayitavya / paranatnanastu svarupavyapasrayanOtasinyan nayavyapasrayan ca pravartakatvanityastyatisaya / 7 / ankitvanupapates ca

s: इतश्च न प्रधानस्य प्रवृत्तिरवल्पते / यद्धि सत्त्वरजस्तमसामान्योन्यगुणप्रधानभावमुत्सृज्य साम्येन स्वरूपमात्रेणावस्थानं सा प्रधानावस्था / तस्य

pk: aTapi syadanyaTa vayananunininahe yaTa nayananantaro dosa prasajyeta / nahyanapeksasvaBava kuwasTascasnaBirguna aByupaganyante prananaBavat / karyavasena tu gunanan svaBavo Byupaganyate / yaTa yaTa karyotpada upapadyate taTa taTEsan svaBavo Byupaganyate / calan gunavrtaniti castyaByupagana / tasnatsanyavasTayanapi vEsanyopaganayogya eva guna avatisWanta iti / evanapi praDanasya jnasaktiviyogadracananupapatyadaya purvokta dosastadavasTa eva / jnasaktinapi tvanuninana prativaditvanivarteta / cetananekananekaprapancasya jagata upadananiti brahnavadaprasangat / vEsanyopaganayogya api guna sanyavasTayan ninitaBavanEva vEsanyan Bajeran / Bajanana va ninitaBavavisesatsarvadEva vEsanyan Bajeraniti prasajyata evayananantaro pi dosa / 9 / vipratiseDac casananjasan
ck: atapi syatanyata vayananunininahe yata nayananantaro tosa prasacyeta / nahyanapeksasvapava kutastascasnapirkuna apyupakanyante prananapavat / karyavasena tu kunanan svapavo pyupakanyate / yata yata karyotpata upapatyate tata tatEsan svapavo pyupakanyate / calan kunavrtaniti castyapyupakana / tasnatsanyavastayanapi vEsanyopakanayokya eva kuna avatistanta iti / evanapi pratanasya cnasaktiviyokatracananupapatyataya purvokta tosastatavasta eva / cnasaktinapi tvanuninana prativatitvanivarteta / cetananekananekaprapancasya cakata upatananiti prahnavataprasankat / vEsanyopakanayokya api kuna sanyavastayan ninitapavanEva vEsanyan paceran / pacanana va ninitapavavisesatsarvatEva vEsanyan paceraniti prasacyata evayananantaro pi tosa / 9 / vipratisetac casanancasan
s: अथापि स्यादन्यथा वयमनुमिमीमहे यथा नायमनन्तरो दोषः प्रसज्येत / नह्यनपेक्षस्वभावाः कूटस्थाश्चास्माभिर्गुणा अभ्युपगम्यन्ते प्रमाणाभावात् / कार्

pk: parasparavirudDascayan sanKyananaByupagana / kvacitsaptendriyanyanukrananti, kvacidekadasa / taTa kvacinahatastanatrasarganupadisanti, kvacidahankirat / taTa kvacitrinyantakaranani varnayanti ck: itascanupapatistarkikaparikalpitasyesvarasya / sa hi sarvacnastErapyupakanyate nantasca / anantan ca pratanananantasca purusa nito pina apyupakanyate / tatra sarvacnesvarena pratanasya purusananatnanasceyata paricityeta va na va paricityeta / upayatapi toso nusakta eva / katan / purvasninstavatvikalpa iyataparicinatvatpratanapurusesvarananantavatvanavasyan pavyevan loke trstatvat / yati loka iyataparicinan vastu patati tatantavatrstan tata pratanapurusesvaratrayanapiyataparicinatvatantavatsyat / sankyaparinanan tavatpratanapurusesvaratrayarupena paricinan / svarupaparinananapi tatkatanisvarena paricityeteti / purusakata ca nahasankya / tatasceyataparicinanan natye ye sansarina sansaranucyante tesan sansaro ntavansansaritvan ca tesanantavat / evanitaresvapi kranena nucyananesu sansarasya sansarinan cantavatvan syat / pratanan ca savikaran purusartanisvarasyatisteyan sansaritvenapinatan tacunyatayanisvara kinatitistet / kinvisaye va sarvacnatesvarate syatan / pratanapurusesvaranan cEvanantavatve satyatinatvaprasanka / atyantavatve ca sunyavataprasanka / ata na putesa tosa ityutaro vikalpo pyupakanyeta na pratanasya purusananatnanasceyatesvarena paricityata iti, tata isvarasya sarvacnatvapyupakanahaniraparo tosa prasacyeta / tasnatapyasankatastarkikaparikrhita isvarakaranavata / 41 / pn: sankya va parinanan veyata / 8 utpatyasanpavatikaranan / su. 42-45 utpatyasanpavat

pk: yesanaprakrtiraDisWata kevalaninitakarananisvaro Binatastesan paksa pratyaKyata / yesan puna prakrtiscaDisWata coBayatnakan karananisvaro Binatastesan paksa pratyaKyayayate / nanu srutisanasrayanenapyevanrupa evesvara pranirDarita prakrtiscaDisWata ceti / srutyanusarini ca snrti pranananiti sTiti / tatkasya hetoresa paksa pratyaciKyasita iti / ucyate- yadyapyevajatiyakonsa sananatvana visanvadagocaro Bavatyastitvansantaran visanvadasTananityatastatpratyaKyanayaranaBa / tatra Bagavata nanyante / BagavanevEko vasudevo niranjanajnanasvarupa paranarTatatvan, sa caturDatnanan praviBajya pratisWito vasudevavyuharupena sankarsanavyuharupena pradyunavyuharupenanirudDavyuharupena ca / vasudevo nana paranatnocyate / sankarsano nana jiva / pradyuno nana nana / anirudDo nanahankara / tesan vasudeva para parakrtiritare sankarsanadaya karyan / tanitTanButan paranesvaran BagavantanaBigananopadanejyasvaDyayayogErvarsasataniswva ksinakleso Bagavantaneva pratipadyata iti / tatra yatavaducyeta yo sO narayana paro vyaktatprasidDa paranatna sarvatna sa atnanatnanananekaDa vyuhyavasTita iti, tana nirakriyate, sa ekaDa Bavati triDa Bavati (Ca. 7.26.2) ityadisrutiBya paranatnano nekaDaBavasyaDigatatvat / yadapi tasya Bagavato BigananadilaksananaraDananajasranananyacitatayaBipreyate, tadapi na pratisiDyate / srutisnrtyorisvarapraniDanasya prasidDatvat / yatpunaridanucyate vasudevatsankarsana utpadyate sankarsanaca pradyuna pradyunacanirudDa iti / atra bruna - na vasudevasanjnakatparanatnana sankarsanasanjnakasya jivasyotpati sanBavati / anityatvadidosaprasangat / utpatinatve hi jivasyanityatvadayo dosa prasajyeran / tatasca nEvasya Bagavatpraptirnoksa syat / karanapraptO karyasya pravilayaprasangat / pratiseDisyati cacaryo jivasyotpatin- natnasruternityatvaca taBya (bra.su. 2.3.17) iti / tasnadasangatEsa kalpana / Pn: vyuho nurti / vakayacetasanavaDanapurvakan devatagrhaganananaBigananan, pujadravyananarjananupadanan, ijya puja, svaDyayo swaksaradijapa, yogo Dyanan / na ca kartu karanan

pk: viyatpavanayorasanBavyananajananorapyutpatinupasrutya brahnano pi Bavetkutascidutpatiriti syatkasyacinati / taTa vikareBya evakasadiBya utaresan vikarananutpatinupasrutyakasasyapi vikaradeva brahnana utpatiriti kascinanyeta / tanasankanapanetunidan sutran- asanBavastu iti / na Kalu brahnana sadatnakasya kutascidanyata sanBava utpatirasankitavya / kasnat / anupapate / sanatran hi brahna / na tasya sanatradevotpati sanBavati, asatyatisaye prakrtivikaraBavanupapate / napi sadvisesadrswaviparyayat / sananyadDi visesa utpadyanana drsyante nrdaderGawadayo natu viseseBya sananyan / napyasato niratnakatvat / kaTanasata sajayeta (Ca. 8.7.1) iti caksepasravanat / sa karanan karanaDipaDipo na casya kascijanita na caDipa (sve. 6.9) iti ca brahnano janayitaran varayati / vivatvapavanayo punarutpati pradarsita natu brahnana sastiti vEsanyan / naca vikareByo vikarantarotpatidarsanadbrahnano pi vikaratvan Bavitunarhatiti nulaprakrtyanaByupagane navastaprasangat / ya nulaprakrtiraByupaganyate tadeva ca no brahnetyaviroDa / 9 / 4 tejo Dikaranan / su. 10 tejo tas taTa hy aha

ck: ta apa Eksanta pahvaya syana pracayenahiti ta ananasrcanta (ca. 6.2.4) iti sruyate / tatra sansaya - kinanenanasaptena vrihiyavatyapyavaharyE cOtanatyucyate kin va prtiviti / tatra praptan tavatvrihiyavatyotanati va parikrahitavyaniti / tatra hyanasapta prasito loke vakyaseso pyetanartanupotvalayati / tasnatyatra kvaca varsati tateva puyistananan pavatiti / vrihiyavatyeva hi sati varsane pahu pavati na prtiviti / evan prapte pruna prtivyeveyananasaptenatpyo cayanana vivaksyata iti / kasnat / atikaratrupacaptantaraca / atikarastavat- tateco srcata tatapo srcata iti nahaputavisayo vartate / tatra kranapraptan prtivin nahaputan vilankya nakasnatvrihyatiparikraho nyaya / tata rupanapi vakyasese prtivyanukunan trsyate yatkrsnan tatanasya iti / nahyotanaterapyavaharyasya krsnatvaniyano sti / napi vrihyatinan / nanu prtivya api nEva krsnatvaniyano sti payapanturasyankararohitasya ca ksetrasya tarsanat / nayan tosa / pahulyapeksatvat / puyistan hi prtivya krsnan rupan na tata svetarohite / pOranika api prtivicayan sarvarinupatisanti / sa ca krsnapasetyata krsnan rupan prtivya iti slisyate / srutyantaranapi sananatikaranatpya prtiviti pavati / tatyatapan sara asitatsanahanyata sa prtivyapavat (pr. 1.2.2) iti ca / prtivyastu vrihyaterutpatin tarsayati- prtivya osataya osatipyo nan iti ca / evanatikaratisu prtivya pratipatakesu satsu kuto vrihyatipratipati / prasitirapyatikaratipireva patyate / vakyaseso pi partivatvatanatyasya tatvarena prtivya evatpya prapavatvan sucayatiti trastavyan / tasnatprtiviyananasapteti / 12 / pn: tatatra srstikale yatapan saranantavatkanipava asitsa eva sanahanyata katina sankato put / 7 tatapityanatikaranan / su. 13 tatapityanat eva tu talinkat sa

pk: kininani viyadadini Butani svayaneva svavikaransrjantyahosvatparanesvara eva tena tenatnanavatisWanano BiDyayanstan tan vikaran srjatiti sandehe sati praptan tavatsvayaneva srjantiti / kuta / akasadvayurvayoragni ityadisvatantryasravanat / nanvacetananan svatantranan pravrti pratisidDa / nEsa dosa / tateja Eksata ta apa Eksanta (Ca. 6.2.4) iti ca Butananapi cetanatvasravanaditi / evan prapte BiDiyate- sa eva paranesvarastena tenatnanavatisWanano BiDyayanstan tan vikaran srjatiti / kuta / talingat / taTahi sastran- ya prTivyan tisWan prTivya antaro yan prTivi na veda yasya prTivi sariran ya prTivinantaro yanayati (br. 3.7.3) ityevanjatiyakan saDyaksananeva Butanan pravrtin darsayati / taTa so kanayata bahu syan prajayeya iti prastutya saca tyacaBavat / tadatnanan svayanakuruta (tE. 2.6.1) iti ca tasyEva ca sarvatnaBavan darsayati / yatviksanasravananaptejasostatparanesvaravesavasadeva draswavyan nanyo to sti draswa (br. 3.7.23) itiksitrantarapratiseDat, prakrtatvaca sata iksitu tadEksata bahu syan prajayeya ityatra / 13 / Pn: paranesvarasyantaryaniBavenavesa sanbanDastadvasadButesviksanan sravanan nEtavata tesan cetanatvan svatantryan vetyarTa / 8 viparyayaDikaranan / su. 14 viparyayena tu krano ta upapadyate ca
ck: kininani viyatatini putani svayaneva svavikaransrcantyahosvatparanesvara eva tena tenatnanavatistanano pityayanstan tan vikaran srcatiti santehe sati praptan tavatsvayaneva srcantiti / kuta / akasatvayurvayorakni ityatisvatantryasravanat / nanvacetananan svatantranan pravrti pratisita / nEsa tosa / tateca Eksata ta apa Eksanta (ca. 6.2.4) iti ca putananapi cetanatvasravanatiti / evan prapte pitiyate- sa eva paranesvarastena tenatnanavatistanano pityayanstan tan vikaran srcatiti / kuta / talinkat / tatahi sastran- ya prtivyan tistan prtivya antaro yan prtivi na veta yasya prtivi sariran ya prtivinantaro yanayati (pr. 3.7.3) ityevancatiyakan satyaksananeva putanan pravrtin tarsayati / tata so kanayata pahu syan pracayeya iti prastutya saca tyacapavat / tatatnanan svayanakuruta (tE. 2.6.1) iti ca tasyEva ca sarvatnapavan tarsayati / yatviksanasravananaptecasostatparanesvaravesavasateva trastavyan nanyo to sti trasta (pr. 3.7.23) itiksitrantarapratisetat, prakrtatvaca sata iksitu tatEksata pahu syan pracayeya ityatra / 13 / pn: paranesvarasyantaryanipavenavesa sanpantastatvasatputesviksanan sravanan nEtavata tesan cetanatvan svatantryan vetyarta / 8 viparyayatikaranan / su. 14 viparyayena tu krano ta upapatyate ca

pk: Butananutpatikranascintita / aTedaninapyayakranascintyate / kinaniyatena kranenapyaya utpatikranenaTava tadvipariteneti / trayo pi cotpatisTitipralaya Butanan brahnayata sruyante- yato va inani Butani jayante / yena jatani jivanti yatprayantyaBisanvisanti (tE. 3.1.1) iti / tatraniyano visesaditi praptan / aTavotpate kranasya srutatvapralayasyapi kranakanksina sa eva krana syaditi / evan praptan tato bruna viparyayena tu pralayakrano ta utpatikranadBavitunarhati / taTahi loke drsyate yena kranena sopananaruQastato viparitena kranenavarohatiti / apica drsyate nrdo jatan Gawasaravadyapyayakale nrdBavanapyetyadByasca jatan hinakarakadyabBavanapyetiti / atascopapadyata etat / yadprTivyadByo jata sati sTitikalavyatikrantavapo piyadapasca tejaso jata satyastejo piyu / evan kranena suksnan suksnataran canantarananantaran karananapitya sarvan karyajatan paranakaranan paranasuksnan ca brahnapyetiti veditavyan / nahi svakaranavyatikranena karanakarane karyapyayo nyaya / snrtavapyutpatikranaviparyayenEvapyayakranastatra tatra darsita - jagatpratisWa devarse prTivyapsu praliyate / jyotisyapa praliyante jyotirvayO praliyate ityevanadO / utpatikranastutpataveva srutatvanapyaye Bavitunarhati / nacasavayogyatvadapyayenakanksyate / nahi karye Driyanane karanasyapyayo yukta karanapyaye karyasyavasTananupapate / karyapyaye tu karanasyavasTanan yuktan nrdadisvevan drswatvat / 14 / Pn: kranena paranparaya / 9 antaravijnanaDikaranan / su. 15 antara vijnanananasi kranena talingad iti cen navisesat

pk: ButananutpatipralayavanulonapratilonakranaByan Bavata ityuktan / atnadirutpati pralayascatnanta ityapyuktan / sendriyasya tu nanaso budDesca sadBava prasidDa srutisnrtyo / budDin tu saraTin vidDi nana pragrahaneva ca / indriyani hayanahu (kaWa. 3.3) ityadilingeBya / tayorapi kasniscidantarale kranenotpatipralayavupasangrahyO, sarvasya vastujatasya brahnajatvaByupaganat / apicaTarvana utpatiprakarane Butananatnanascantarale karananyanukranyante / etasnajayate prano nana sarvendriyani ca / Kan vayurjyotirapa prTivi visvasya Darini (nunaqa. 2.1.3) iti / tasnatpurvoktotpatipralayakranaBangaprasango Butananiti cet / na / avisesat / yadi tavadBOtikani karanani tato ButotpatipralayaByanevEsanutpatipralayO Bavata iti nEtayo kranantaran nrgyan / Bavati ca BOtikatve lingan karananan / ananayan hi sonya nana osaDaya pranastejonayi vak (Ca. 6.5.4) ityevajatiyakan / vyapadeso pi kvacidButanan karananan ca brahnanaparivrajakanyayena netavya / aTa tvaBOtikani karanani taTapi Butotpatikrano na karanErvisesyate praTanan karananyutpadyante caranan Butani praTanan va Butanyutpadyante caranan va karananiti / aTarvane tu sananayakrananatran karananan Butanan ca / na tatrotpatikrana ucyate / taTanyatrapi prTageva Butakranatkaranakrana anayate- prajapatirva idanagra asitsa atnananEksata sa nano srjata tanana evasitadatnananEksata tadvacanasrjata ityadina / tasnanasti Butotpatikranasya Banga / 15 / Pn: anyapara sabda linganityucyante / idan sTulanutpate prak prajapati sutratna asit / 10 caracaravyapasrayaDikaranan / su. 16 caracaravyapasrayas tu syat tadvyapadeso Baktas tadBavaBavitvat
ck: putananutpatipralayavanulonapratilonakranapyan pavata ityuktan / atnatirutpati pralayascatnanta ityapyuktan / sentriyasya tu nanaso putesca satpava prasita srutisnrtyo / putin tu saratin viti nana prakrahaneva ca / intriyani hayanahu (kata. 3.3) ityatilinkepya / tayorapi kasniscitantarale kranenotpatipralayavupasankrahyO, sarvasya vastucatasya prahnacatvapyupakanat / apicatarvana utpatiprakarane putananatnanascantarale karananyanukranyante / etasnacayate prano nana sarventriyani ca / kan vayurcyotirapa prtivi visvasya tarini (nunata. 2.1.3) iti / tasnatpurvoktotpatipralayakranapankaprasanko putananiti cet / na / avisesat / yati tavatpOtikani karanani tato putotpatipralayapyanevEsanutpatipralayO pavata iti nEtayo kranantaran nrkyan / pavati ca pOtikatve linkan karananan / ananayan hi sonya nana osataya pranasteconayi vak (ca. 6.5.4) ityevacatiyakan / vyapateso pi kvacitputanan karananan ca prahnanaparivracakanyayena netavya / ata tvapOtikani karanani tatapi putotpatikrano na karanErvisesyate pratanan karananyutpatyante caranan putani pratanan va putanyutpatyante caranan va karananiti / atarvane tu sananayakrananatran karananan putanan ca / na tatrotpatikrana ucyate / tatanyatrapi prtakeva putakranatkaranakrana anayate- pracapatirva itanakra asitsa atnananEksata sa nano srcata tanana evasitatatnananEksata tatvacanasrcata ityatina / tasnanasti putotpatikranasya panka / 15 / pn: anyapara sapta linkanityucyante / itan stulanutpate prak pracapati sutratna asit / 10 caracaravyapasrayatikaranan / su. 16 caracaravyapasrayas tu syat tatvyapateso paktas tatpavapavitvat

pk: sto jivasyapyutpatipralayO, jato devadato nrto devadata ityevajatiyakalOkikavyapadesat jatakarnadisanskaraviDanaceti syatkasyacdBrantistanapanudana / na jivasyotpatipralayO sta, sastraPalasanbanDopapate / sariranuvinasini hi jive sarirantakagateswaniswapraptiparihararTO viDipratiseDavanartakO syatan / sruyate ca- jivapetan vava kiledan nriyate na jivo nriyate (Ca. 6.1.3) iti / nanu lOkiko jananaranavyapadeso jivasya darsita / satyan darsita / Baktastvesa jivasya jananaranavyapadesa / kinasraya punarayan nuKyo yadapeksaya Bakta iti / ucyate- caracaravyapasraya / sTavarajanganasariravisayO jananaranasabdO / sTavarajanganani hi Butani jayante ca nriyante catastadvisayO jananaranasabdO nuKyO santO tatsTe jivatnanyupacaryate, tadBavaBavitvat / sarirapradurBavatiroBavayorhi satorjananaranasabdO Bavato nasato / nahi sarirasanbanDadanyatra jivo jato nrto va kenacilaksyate / sa va ayan puruso jayanana sariranaBisanpadyanana sa utkranan nriyanana (br. 4.3.8) iti ca sarirasanyogaviyoganinitaveva jananaranasabdO darsayati / jatakarnadiviDananapi dehapradurBavapeksaneva draswavyan / aBavajivapradurBavasya / jivasya parasnadatnana utpatirviyadadinanivasti nasti vetyetadutarena sutrena vaksyati / dehasrayO tavajivasya sTulavutpatipralayO na sta ityetadanena sutrenavocat / 16 / Pn: jivapetan jivena tyaktanidan sariran / 1 atnaDiranan / su. 17 natna sruter nityatvac ca taBya
ck: sto civasyapyutpatipralayO, cato tevatato nrto tevatata ityevacatiyakalOkikavyapatesat catakarnatisanskaravitanaceti syatkasyactprantistanapanutana / na civasyotpatipralayO sta, sastrapalasanpantopapate / sariranuvinasini hi cive sarirantakakatestanistapraptipariharartO vitipratisetavanartakO syatan / sruyate ca- civapetan vava kiletan nriyate na civo nriyate (ca. 6.1.3) iti / nanu lOkiko cananaranavyapateso civasya tarsita / satyan tarsita / paktastvesa civasya cananaranavyapatesa / kinasraya punarayan nukyo yatapeksaya pakta iti / ucyate- caracaravyapasraya / stavaracankanasariravisayO cananaranasaptO / stavaracankanani hi putani cayante ca nriyante catastatvisayO cananaranasaptO nukyO santO tatste civatnanyupacaryate, tatpavapavitvat / sarirapraturpavatiropavayorhi satorcananaranasaptO pavato nasato / nahi sarirasanpantatanyatra civo cato nrto va kenacilaksyate / sa va ayan puruso cayanana sariranapisanpatyanana sa utkranan nriyanana (pr. 4.3.8) iti ca sarirasanyokaviyokaninitaveva cananaranasaptO tarsayati / catakarnativitananapi tehapraturpavapeksaneva trastavyan / apavacivapraturpavasya / civasya parasnatatnana utpatirviyatatinanivasti nasti vetyetatutarena sutrena vaksyati / tehasrayO tavacivasya stulavutpatipralayO na sta ityetatanena sutrenavocat / 16 / pn: civapetan civena tyaktanitan sariran / 1 atnatiranan / su. 17 natna sruter nityatvac ca tapya

ck: yatitanavityavastayanupatinipantanan kartrtvan civasyapihitan, tatkinanapeksyesvaran pavatyahosvitisvarapeksaniti pavati vicarana / tatra praptan tavanesvaranapeksate civa kartrtva iti / kasnat / apeksaprayocanapavat / ayan hi civa svayaneva rakatvesatitosaprayukta karakantarasanakrisanapana kartrtvananupavitun saknoti / tasya kinisvara karisyati / naca loke prasitirasti krsyatikasu kriyasvanatutativatisvaro paro peksitavya iti / klesatnakena ca kartrtvena cantunsansrcata isvarasya nErkrnyan prasacyeta, visanapalan cEsan kartrtvan vitatato vEsanyan / nanu vEsanyanErkrnye na sapeksatvat (pra. 1.4.17) ityuktan / satyanuktan sati tvisvarasya sapeksatvasanpave / sapeksatvan cesvarasya sanpavati satorcantunan tarnatarnayostayosca satpava sati civasya kartrtve / tateva cetkartrtvanisvarapeksan syatkinvisayanisvarasya sapeksatvanucyeta / akrtapyakanascEvan civasya prasacyeta / tasnatsvata evasya kartrtvaniti / etan praptin tusaptena vyavartya praticanite- parat iti / avityavastayan karyakaranasankatavivekatarsino civasyavityatinirantasya sata parasnatatnana karnatyaksatsarvaputativasatsaksinascetayiturisvaratatanucnaya kartrtvapoktrtvalaksanasya sansarasya siti, tatanukrahahetukenEva ca vicnanena noksasitirpavitunarhati / kuta / tacrute / yatyapi tosaprayukta sanakrisanpanasca civa, yatyapi ca loke krsyatisu karnasu nesvarakaranatvan prasitan, tatapi sarvasveva pravrtisvisvaro hetukarteti sruteravasiyate / tatahi srutirpavati- esa hyeva satu karna karayati tan yanepyo lokepya uniniyate / esa hyevasatu karna karayati tan yanato ninisate (kOsi. 3.8) iti / ya atnani tistanatnananantaro yanayati iti cEvancatiyaka / 41 / nanvevanisvarasya karayitrtve sati vEsanyanErkanye syatanakrtapyakanasca civasyeti / netyucyate- krtaprayatnapeksas tu vihitapratisitavEyartyatipya

pk: tusabdascoditadosavyavartanarTa / krto ya prayatno jivasya DarnaDarnalaksanastadapeksa evEnanisvara karayati / tatascEte codita dosa na prasajyante / jivakrtaDarnaDarnavEsanyapeksa eva tatatPalani visanan viBajetparjanyavadisvaro ninitatvanatrena / yaTa loke nanaviDanan gucCagulnadinan vrihiyavadinan casaDaraneBya svasvabijeByo jayanananan saDaranan ninitan Bavati parjanya / nahyasati parjanye rasapaspapalasadivEsanyan tesan jayate, napyasatsu svasvabijesu, evan jivakrtaprayatnapeksa isvarastesan suBasuBan vidaDyaditi slisyate / nanu krtaprayatnapeksatvaneva jivasya parayate kartrtve nopapadyate / nEsa dosa / parayate pi hi kartrtve karotyeva jiva / kurvantan hi tanisvara karayati / apica purvaprayatnanapeksyedanin karayati purvataran ca prayatnanapeksya purvanakarayadityanaditvatsansarasyetyanavadyan / kaTan punaravaganyate krtapratnapeksa isvara iti / vihitapratisidDavEyarTyadiBya ityaha / evan hi svargakano yajeta brahnano na hantavya, ityevanjatiyakasya vihitasya pratisidDasya cavEyarTyan Bavati / anyaTa tadanarTakan syat / isvara eva viDipratiseDayorniyujyeta / atyantaparatantratvajivasya / taTa vihitakarinanapyanarTena sansrjetpratisidDakarinanapyarTena / tatasca prananyan vedasyastaniyat / isvarasya catyantanapeksatve lOkikasyapi purusakarasya vEyarTyan taTa desakalaninitanan purvoktadosaprasangascetyevanjatiyakan dosajatanadigrahanena darsayati / 42 / 17 ansaDikaranan / su. 43-53 anso nanavyapadesad anyaTa capi dasakitavaditvan aDiyata eke
ck: tusaptascotitatosavyavartanarta / krto ya prayatno civasya tarnatarnalaksanastatapeksa evEnanisvara karayati / tatascEte cotita tosa na prasacyante / civakrtatarnatarnavEsanyapeksa eva tatatpalani visanan vipacetparcanyavatisvaro ninitatvanatrena / yata loke nanavitanan kucakulnatinan vrihiyavatinan casataranepya svasvapicepyo cayanananan sataranan ninitan pavati parcanya / nahyasati parcanye rasapaspapalasativEsanyan tesan cayate, napyasatsu svasvapicesu, evan civakrtaprayatnapeksa isvarastesan supasupan vitatyatiti slisyate / nanu krtaprayatnapeksatvaneva civasya parayate kartrtve nopapatyate / nEsa tosa / parayate pi hi kartrtve karotyeva civa / kurvantan hi tanisvara karayati / apica purvaprayatnanapeksyetanin karayati purvataran ca prayatnanapeksya purvanakarayatityanatitvatsansarasyetyanavatyan / katan punaravakanyate krtapratnapeksa isvara iti / vihitapratisitavEyartyatipya ityaha / evan hi svarkakano yaceta prahnano na hantavya, ityevancatiyakasya vihitasya pratisitasya cavEyartyan pavati / anyata tatanartakan syat / isvara eva vitipratisetayorniyucyeta / atyantaparatantratvacivasya / tata vihitakarinanapyanartena sansrcetpratisitakarinanapyartena / tatasca prananyan vetasyastaniyat / isvarasya catyantanapeksatve lOkikasyapi purusakarasya vEyartyan tata tesakalaninitanan purvoktatosaprasankascetyevancatiyakan tosacatanatikrahanena tarsayati / 42 / 17 ansatikaranan / su. 43-53 anso nanavyapatesat anyata capi tasakitavatitvan atiyata eke

pk: jivesvarayorupakaryopakaraBava ukta / sa ca sanbadDayoreva loke drswo yaTa svaniBrtyayoryaTa vagnivisPulingayo / tatasca jivesvarayorapyupakaryopakarakaBavaByupaganatkin svaniBrtyavatsanbanDa ahosvidagnivisPulingavadityasyan vicikitsayananiyano va prapnoti / aTava svaniBrtyaprakaresvevesitrisitavyaBavasya prasidDatvatadviDa eva sanbanDa iti prapnoti / ato bravityansa iti / jiva isvasyanso Bavitunarhati, yaTagnervisPulinga / ansa ivanso nahi niravayavasya nuKyonsa sanBavati / kasnatpunarniravayavatvatsa eva na Bavati / nanavyapadesat / so nveswavya sa vijijnasitavya (Ca. 8.7.1) etaneva viditva nunirBavati ya atnani tisWanatnananantaro yanayati iti cEvanjatiyako Bedanirdeso nasati Bede yujyate / nanu cayan nanavyapadesa sutaran svaniBrtyasarupye yujyata ityata aha- anyaTa capiti / naca nanavyapadesadeva kevaladansatvapratipti / kin tarhyanyaTa capi vyapadeso Bavatyananatvasya pratipadaka / taTahi- eke saKino dasakitavadiBavan brahnana ananantyaTarvanika brahnasukte- brahna dasa brahna dasa brahnEvene kitava ityadina / dasa ya ete kEvarta prasidDa, ye cani dasa svanisvatnananupaksapayanti, ye canye kitava dyutakrtaste sarve brahnEveti hinajantudaharanena sarvesaneva nanarupakrtakaryakaranasanGatapraviswanan jivanan brahnatvanaha / taTanyatrapi brahnaprakriyayanevayanarTa prapancyate- tvan stri tvan punanasi tvan kunara uta va kunari / tvan jirno danqena vancasi tvan jato Bavasi visvatonuKa (sve. 4.3) iti / sarvani rupani vicitya Diro nanani krtvaBivadanyadaste iti ca / nanyo to sti draswa (brca 3.7.23) ityadisrutiByascasyarTasya sidDi / cEtanyan cavisiswan jivesvarayoryaTagnivisPulingayorOsnyan / ato BedaBedavaganaByanansatvavagana / 43 / kutascansatvavagana - nantravarnac ca
ck: civesvarayorupakaryopakarapava ukta / sa ca sanpatayoreva loke trsto yata svaniprtyayoryata vaknivispulinkayo / tatasca civesvarayorapyupakaryopakarakapavapyupakanatkin svaniprtyavatsanpanta ahosvitaknivispulinkavatityasyan vicikitsayananiyano va prapnoti / atava svaniprtyaprakaresvevesitrisitavyapavasya prasitatvatatvita eva sanpanta iti prapnoti / ato pravityansa iti / civa isvasyanso pavitunarhati, yataknervispulinka / ansa ivanso nahi niravayavasya nukyonsa sanpavati / kasnatpunarniravayavatvatsa eva na pavati / nanavyapatesat / so nvestavya sa vicicnasitavya (ca. 8.7.1) etaneva vititva nunirpavati ya atnani tistanatnananantaro yanayati iti cEvancatiyako petanirteso nasati pete yucyate / nanu cayan nanavyapatesa sutaran svaniprtyasarupye yucyata ityata aha- anyata capiti / naca nanavyapatesateva kevalatansatvapratipti / kin tarhyanyata capi vyapateso pavatyananatvasya pratipataka / tatahi- eke sakino tasakitavatipavan prahnana ananantyatarvanika prahnasukte- prahna tasa prahna tasa prahnEvene kitava ityatina / tasa ya ete kEvarta prasita, ye cani tasa svanisvatnananupaksapayanti, ye canye kitava tyutakrtaste sarve prahnEveti hinacantutaharanena sarvesaneva nanarupakrtakaryakaranasankatapravistanan civanan prahnatvanaha / tatanyatrapi prahnaprakriyayanevayanarta prapancyate- tvan stri tvan punanasi tvan kunara uta va kunari / tvan cirno tantena vancasi tvan cato pavasi visvatonuka (sve. 4.3) iti / sarvani rupani vicitya tiro nanani krtvapivatanyataste iti ca / nanyo to sti trasta (prca 3.7.23) ityatisrutipyascasyartasya siti / cEtanyan cavisistan civesvarayoryataknivispulinkayorOsnyan / ato petapetavakanapyanansatvavakana / 43 / kutascansatvavakana - nantravarnac ca

ck: yata civa sansaratukananupavati nEvan para isvaro nupavatiti praticaninahe / civo hyavityavesavasatehatyatnapavaniva katva tatkrtena tukena tukyahanityavityaya krtan tukopapokanapinanyate / nEvan paranesvarasya tehatyatnapavo tukapinano vasti / civasyapyavityakrtananarupanirvrtatehentriyatyupatyavivekaprananinita eva tukapinano natu paranartiko sti / yataca svatehakatatahacetatininitan tukan tatapinanaprantyanupavati tata putranitratikocaranapi tukan tatapinanaprantyEvanupavatyahaneva putro haneva nitranityevan snehavasena putranitratisvapinivisanana / tatasca niscitanetatavakanyate- nityapinanaprananinita eva tukanupava iti / vyatirekatarsanacEvanavakanyate / tatahi- putranitratinatsu pahusupavistesu tatsanpantapinanisvitaresu ca putro nrto nitran nrtanityevanatyutkosite yesaneva putranitratinatvapinanastesaneva taninitan tukanutpatyate napinanahinanan parivracakatinan / atasca lOkikasyapi punsa sanyaktarsanartavatvan trstan, kinuta visayasunyatatnano nyatvastvantaranapasyato nityacEtanyanatrasvarupasyeti / tasnanasti sanyaktarsananartakyaprasanka / prakasativatiti nitarsanopanyasa / yata prakasa sOrascantranaso va viyatvyapyavatistanano nkulyatyupatisanpantatesvrcuvakratipavan pratipatyananesu tatatpavaniva pratipatyanano pi na paranartatastatpavan pratipatyate / yata cakaso katatisu kacatsu kacaniva vipavyanano pi na paranartato kacati, yata cotasaravatikanpanatatkate suryapratipinpe kanpanane pi na tatvansurya kanpate, evanavityapratyupastapite putyatyupahite civakyense tukayanane pi na tatvanisvaro tukayate / civasyapi tu tukapraptiravityaninitEvetyuktan / tatacavityaninitacivapavavyutasena prahnapavaneva civasya pratipatayanti vetanta tatvanasi ityevanataya, tasnanasti cEvena tukena paranatnano tukitvaprasanka / 46 / pn: itaresvapinanasunyesu / snaranti ca
s: यथा जीवः संसारदुःखमनुभवति नैवं पर ईश्वरो ऽनुभवतीति प्रतिजानीमहे / जीवो ह्यविद्यावेशवशाद्देहाद्यात्मभावमिव गत्वा तत्कृतेन दुःखेन दुःख्यहमित्य

pk: snaranti ca vyasadayo yaTa jEvena duKena na paranatna duKayata iti / tatra ya paranatna hi sa nityo nirguna snrta / na lipyate PalEscapi padnapatranivanBasa / karnatna tvaparo yo sO noksabanDanE sa yujyate / sa saptadasakenapi rasina yujyate puna iti / casabdatsananananti ceti vakyasesa / tayoranya pipalan svadvatyanasnananyo aBicakasiti (sve. 4.6) iti / ekastaTa sarvaButantaratna na lipyate lokaduKena bahya (kaWa. 5.1) iti ca / 47 / atraha- yadi tarhyeka eva sarvesan Butananantaratna syatkaTananujnapariharO syatan lokikO vEdikO ceti / nanu canso jiva isvarasyetyuktan / tadBedacanujnapariharO tadasrayavavyatikirnavupapadyete kinatra codyata iti / ucyate- nEtadevan / anansitvanapi hi jivasyaBedavadinya srutaya pratipadayanti- tatsrswva tadevanupravisat (te. 2.6.1), nanyo to sti draswa (br. 3.7.23), nrtyo sa nrtyunapnoti ya iha naneva pasyati (br. 4.4.19), tatvanasi (Ca. 6.8.7) ahan brahnasni (br. 1.4.10) ityevanjatiyaka / nanu BedaBedavaganaByanansatvan sidDyatityuktan / syadetadevan yadyuBavapi BedaBedO pratipipadayisitO syatan, aBeda eva tvatra pratipipadayisito brahnatnatvapratipatO purusarTasidDe / svaBavapraptastu Bedo nudyate / naca niravayavasya brahnano nuKyonso jiva sanBavatityuktan / tasnatpara evEka sarvesan Butananantaratna jivaBavenavasTita ityato vaktavyanujnapariharopapati / 47 / Pn: tatra jivaparayornaDye / karnatna karnasrayo jiva / saptadasakena dasendrayani panca prana nano budisceti saptadasasanKyako rasirlingan / nrtyo sa nrtyu - iha brahnani yo naneva kalpitaBedasali cetanacetanatnakan visvan pasyati sa nrtyoranantaran nrtyun jananaranadiparanpararupan sansaran prapnotityarTa / tan bruna - anujnapariharO dehasanbanDaj jyotiradivat
ck: snaranti ca vyasatayo yata cEvena tukena na paranatna tukayata iti / tatra ya paranatna hi sa nityo nirkuna snrta / na lipyate palEscapi patnapatranivanpasa / karnatna tvaparo yo sO noksapantanE sa yucyate / sa saptatasakenapi rasina yucyate puna iti / casaptatsananananti ceti vakyasesa / tayoranya pipalan svatvatyanasnananyo apicakasiti (sve. 4.6) iti / ekastata sarvaputantaratna na lipyate lokatukena pahya (kata. 5.1) iti ca / 47 / atraha- yati tarhyeka eva sarvesan putananantaratna syatkatananucnapariharO syatan lokikO vEtikO ceti / nanu canso civa isvarasyetyuktan / tatpetacanucnapariharO tatasrayavavyatikirnavupapatyete kinatra cotyata iti / ucyate- nEtatevan / anansitvanapi hi civasyapetavatinya srutaya pratipatayanti- tatsrstva tatevanupravisat (te. 2.6.1), nanyo to sti trasta (pr. 3.7.23), nrtyo sa nrtyunapnoti ya iha naneva pasyati (pr. 4.4.19), tatvanasi (ca. 6.8.7) ahan prahnasni (pr. 1.4.10) ityevancatiyaka / nanu petapetavakanapyanansatvan sityatityuktan / syatetatevan yatyupavapi petapetO pratipipatayisitO syatan, apeta eva tvatra pratipipatayisito prahnatnatvapratipatO purusartasite / svapavapraptastu peto nutyate / naca niravayavasya prahnano nukyonso civa sanpavatityuktan / tasnatpara evEka sarvesan putananantaratna civapavenavastita ityato vaktavyanucnapariharopapati / 47 / pn: tatra civaparayornatye / karnatna karnasrayo civa / saptatasakena tasentrayani panca prana nano putisceti saptatasasankyako rasirlinkan / nrtyo sa nrtyu - iha prahnani yo naneva kalpitapetasali cetanacetanatnakan visvan pasyati sa nrtyoranantaran nrtyun cananaranatiparanpararupan sansaran prapnotityarta / tan pruna - anucnapariharO tehasanpantac cyotirativat
s: स्मरन्ति च व्यासादयो यथा जैवेन दुःखेन न परमात्मा दुःखायत इति / ऽतत्र यः परमात्मा हि स नित्यो निर्गुणः स्मृतः / न लिप्यते फलैश्चापि पद्मपत्रम

pk: rtO Baryanupeyat ityanujna / gurvanganan nopagacCet iti parihara / taTa agnisoniyan pasun sanjnapayet ityanujna / na hinsyatsarvaButani iti parihara / evan loke pi nitranupasevitavyanityanujna / satru parihartavya iti parihara / evanprakaravanujnapariharavekatve pyatnano dehasanbanDatsyatan / dehE sanbanDo dehasanbanDa / ka punardehasanbanDa / dehadirayan sanGato hanevetyatnani viparitapratyayotpati / drswa ca sa sarvapraninanahan gacCanyahanagacCanyahananDo hanananDo han nuQo hananuQa ityevanatnika / nahyasya sanyagdarsanadanyanivarakanasti / praktu sanyagdarsanatpratatEsa Branti sarvajantusu / tadevanavidyaninitadehadyupaDisanbanDakrtadvisesadEkatnyaByupagane pyanujnapariharavavakalpyete / sanyagdarsinastarhyanujnapariharanarTakyan praptan / na / tasyakrtarTatvaniyojyatvanupapate / heyopadeyayorhi niyojyo niyoktavya syat / atnanastvatiriktan heyanupadeyan va vastvapasyankaTan niyujyeta / nacatnatnanyeva niyojya syat / sariravyatirekadarsina eva niyojyatvaniti cet / na / tatsanhatatvaBinanat / satyan vyatirekadarsino niyojyatvan taTapi vyonadivadehadyasanhatatvanapasyata evatnano niyojyatvaBinana / nahi dehadyasanhatatvadarsina kasyacidapi niyogo drswa / kinutEkatnyadarsina / naca niyogaBavatsanyagdarsino yaTeswaceswaprasanga / sarvatraBinanasyEva pravartakatvadiBinanaBavaca sanyagdarsina / tasnadehasanbanDadevanujnapariharO / jyotiradivat / yaTa jyotisa ekatve pyagni kravyatparihriyate netara / yaTaca prakasa ekasyapi savituraneDyadesasanbadDa parihriyate netara suciBunisWa / yaTa BOna pradesa vajravEquryadaya upadiyante / BOna api santo narakalevaradaya parihriyante / yaTa nutraparisan gavan pavitrataya parigrhyate tadeva jatyantare parivarjyate tadvat / 48 / Pn: pratata santata / viseso Beda / kravyan nansanatiti kravyat snasanagni / asantates cavyatikara
ck: rtO paryanupeyat ityanucna / kurvankanan nopakacet iti parihara / tata aknisoniyan pasun sancnapayet ityanucna / na hinsyatsarvaputani iti parihara / evan loke pi nitranupasevitavyanityanucna / satru parihartavya iti parihara / evanprakaravanucnapariharavekatve pyatnano tehasanpantatsyatan / tehE sanpanto tehasanpanta / ka punartehasanpanta / tehatirayan sankato hanevetyatnani viparitapratyayotpati / trsta ca sa sarvapraninanahan kacanyahanakacanyahananto hanananto han nuto hananuta ityevanatnika / nahyasya sanyaktarsanatanyanivarakanasti / praktu sanyaktarsanatpratatEsa pranti sarvacantusu / tatevanavityaninitatehatyupatisanpantakrtatvisesatEkatnyapyupakane pyanucnapariharavavakalpyete / sanyaktarsinastarhyanucnapariharanartakyan praptan / na / tasyakrtartatvaniyocyatvanupapate / heyopateyayorhi niyocyo niyoktavya syat / atnanastvatiriktan heyanupateyan va vastvapasyankatan niyucyeta / nacatnatnanyeva niyocya syat / sariravyatirekatarsina eva niyocyatvaniti cet / na / tatsanhatatvapinanat / satyan vyatirekatarsino niyocyatvan tatapi vyonativatehatyasanhatatvanapasyata evatnano niyocyatvapinana / nahi tehatyasanhatatvatarsina kasyacitapi niyoko trsta / kinutEkatnyatarsina / naca niyokapavatsanyaktarsino yatestacestaprasanka / sarvatrapinanasyEva pravartakatvatipinanapavaca sanyaktarsina / tasnatehasanpantatevanucnapariharO / cyotirativat / yata cyotisa ekatve pyakni kravyatparihriyate netara / yataca prakasa ekasyapi savituranetyatesasanpata parihriyate netara sucipunista / yata pOna pratesa vacravEturyataya upatiyante / pOna api santo narakalevarataya parihriyante / yata nutraparisan kavan pavitrataya parikrhyate tateva catyantare parivarcyate tatvat / 48 / pn: pratata santata / viseso peta / kravyan nansanatiti kravyat snasanakni / asantates cavyatikara
s: ऽऋतौ भार्यामुपेयात्ऽ इत्यनुज्ञा / ऽऽगुर्वाङ्गनां नोपगच्छेत्ऽ इति परिहारः / तथा ऽअग्नीषोमीयं पशुं संज्ञपयेत्ऽ इत्यनुज्ञा / ऽन हिंस्यात्सर्वाभ
