pk: aBasa eva cEsa jiva parasyatnano jalasuryakadivatpratipatavya / na sa eva saksat / napi vastvantaran / atasca yaTa nEkasninjalasuryake kanpanane jalasuryakantaran kanpate, evan nEkasninjive karnaPalasanbanDini jivantarasya tatsanbanDa / evanapyavyatikara eva karnaPalayo / aBasasya cavidyakrtatvatadasrayasya sansarasyavidyakrtatvopapatiriti / tadvyudasena ca paranarTikasya brahnatnaBavasyopadesopapati / yesan tu bahava atnanaste ca sarve sarvagatastesanevEsa vyatikara prapnoti / kaTan / bahavo viBavascatnanascEtanyanatrasvarupa nirguna niratisayasca tadarTan saDaranan praDanan taninitEsan BogapavargasidDiriti sanKya / sati bahutve viButve ca Gawakuqyadisanana dravyanatrasvarupa svato cetana atnanastadupakaranani canuni nanansyacetanani / tatratnadravyanan nanodravyanan ca sanyoganavecCadayo vEsesika atnaguna utpadyante / te cavyatirekena pratyekanatnasu sanavayanti sa sansara / tesan navananatnagunananatyantanutpado noksa iti kanada / tatra sanKyanan tavacEtanyasvarupatvatsarvatnanan saniDanadyavisesacEkasya suKaduKasanbanDe sarvesan suKaduKasanbanDa prapnoti / syadetat / praDanapravrte parusakEvalyarTatvadvyavasTa Bavisyati / anyaTa hi svaviButiKyapanarTa praDanapravrti syat / taTacanirnoksa prasajyeteti / nEtatsaran / nahyaBilasitasidDinibanDana vyavasTa sakya vijnatun / upapatya tu kayacidvyavasTocyeta / asatyan punarupapatO kanan na BudaBilasitan purusakEvalyan, prapnoti tu vyavasTahetvaBavadvyatikara / kanadananapi yadEkenatnana nana sanyujyate tadatnantarErapi nantariyaka sanyoga syatsaniDanadyavisesat / tatasca hetvavisesatPalavisesa ityekasyatnana suKaduKayoge sarvatnananapi sananan suKaduKitvan prasajyeta / 50 / syadetat / adrswaninito niyano Bavisyatiti / netyaha- adrswaniyanat
ck: apasa eva cEsa civa parasyatnano calasuryakativatpratipatavya / na sa eva saksat / napi vastvantaran / atasca yata nEkasnincalasuryake kanpanane calasuryakantaran kanpate, evan nEkasnincive karnapalasanpantini civantarasya tatsanpanta / evanapyavyatikara eva karnapalayo / apasasya cavityakrtatvatatasrayasya sansarasyavityakrtatvopapatiriti / tatvyutasena ca paranartikasya prahnatnapavasyopatesopapati / yesan tu pahava atnanaste ca sarve sarvakatastesanevEsa vyatikara prapnoti / katan / pahavo vipavascatnanascEtanyanatrasvarupa nirkuna niratisayasca tatartan sataranan pratanan taninitEsan pokapavarkasitiriti sankya / sati pahutve viputve ca katakutyatisanana travyanatrasvarupa svato cetana atnanastatupakaranani canuni nanansyacetanani / tatratnatravyanan nanotravyanan ca sanyokanavecatayo vEsesika atnakuna utpatyante / te cavyatirekena pratyekanatnasu sanavayanti sa sansara / tesan navananatnakunananatyantanutpato noksa iti kanata / tatra sankyanan tavacEtanyasvarupatvatsarvatnanan sanitanatyavisesacEkasya sukatukasanpante sarvesan sukatukasanpanta prapnoti / syatetat / pratanapravrte parusakEvalyartatvatvyavasta pavisyati / anyata hi svaviputikyapanarta pratanapravrti syat / tatacanirnoksa prasacyeteti / nEtatsaran / nahyapilasitasitinipantana vyavasta sakya vicnatun / upapatya tu kayacitvyavastocyeta / asatyan punarupapatO kanan na putapilasitan purusakEvalyan, prapnoti tu vyavastahetvapavatvyatikara / kanatananapi yatEkenatnana nana sanyucyate tatatnantarErapi nantariyaka sanyoka syatsanitanatyavisesat / tatasca hetvavisesatpalavisesa ityekasyatnana sukatukayoke sarvatnananapi sananan sukatukitvan prasacyeta / 50 / syatetat / atrstaninito niyano pavisyatiti / netyaha- atrstaniyanat
s: आभास एव चैष जीवः परस्यात्मनो जलसूर्यकादिवत्प्रतिपत्तव्यः / न स एव साक्षात् / नापि वस्त्वन्तरम् / अतश्च यथा नैकस्मिञ्जलसूर्यके कम्पमाने जलसूर

ck: utpativisaya srutivipratiseta prananan parihrta / sankyavisaya itanin parihriyate / tatra nukyan prananuparistatvaksyati / sanprati tu katitare prana iti sanpratarayati / srutivipratipatescatra visaya / kvacitsapta prana sankirtyante- sapta prana prapavanti tasnat (nunta. 2.1.8) iti / kvacicastO prana krahatvena kunena sankirtyante- astO kraha astavatikraha (pr. 3.2.1) iti / kvacinava- sapta vE sirsanya prana tvavavancO (tE. san. 5.1.7.1) iti / kvacitasa- nava vE puruse prana napirtasani iti / kvacitekatasa- tasene puruse prana atnEkatasa (pr. 3.9.4) iti / kvacitvatasa- sarvesan sparsanan tvakekayanan (pr. 2.4.1) ityatra / kvacitrayotasa caksusca trastavyan ca (pr. 4.8) ityatra / evan hi vipratipana praneyatan prati srutaya / kin tavatpraptan / saptEva prana iti / kuta kate / yatastavanto vakanyante- sapta prana prapavanti tasnat (nunta. 2.1.8) ityevanvitasu srutisu / visesitascEte sapta vE sirsanya prana ityatra / nanu prana kuhasaya nihita sapta sapta (nunta. 2.1.8) iti vipsa sruyate, sa saptapyo tiriktanpranankanayati / nEsa tosa / purusapetapiprayeyan vipsa pratipurusan sapta sapta prana iti, na tatvapetapipraya sapta saptanye nye prana iti / nanvastatvatikapi sankaya pranesutahrta katan saptEva syu / satyanutahrta / virotatvanyatana sankyatyavasatavya / tatra stokakalpananurotatsaptasankyatyavasanan / vrtipetapeksan ca sankyantarasravananiti nanyate / 5 / pn: visaya sansaya / krahatvan pantakatvan / krhnanti patnantiti kraha intriyani / atikraha krahanatikranta visaya ityarta / avancO payupastO / kate avakate / atrocyate- hastatayas tu stite to nEvan

saptatvanantarBavacCakyate sanBavayitun / hinaDikasanKyavipratipatO hyaDika sanKya sangrahya Bavati tasyan hinantarBavati natu hinayanaDika / atasca nEvan nantavyan stokakalpananuroDatsaptEva prana eva prana aBinata syu / sTanaBedadDyete catvara santa sapta ganyante dve srotre dve caksusi dve nasike eka vak iti / naca tavataneva vrtiBeda itare prana iti sakyate vaktun, praneyatanane sati kva kinparananananiti vivektavyan / karyajatavasatvekadasatvananan pranavisayan pranananiti sTitan / iyanapara sutradvayayojana / saptEva prana syuryata saptananeva gati sruyate- pk: nuKyasca prana itarapranavadbrahnavikara ityatidisati / tacavisesenEva sarvaprananan brahnavikaratvanaKyatan / etasnajayate prano nana sarvendriyani ca (nunqa. 2.1.3) iti sendriyananovyatirekena pranasyotpatisravanat / sa prananasrjata (pra. 6.4) ityadi sravaneByasca / kinarTa punaratidesa, aDikasankapakaranarTa / nasadasiye hi brahnapraDane sukte nantravarno Bavati na nrtyurasidanrtan na tarhi na ratrya ahnu asitpraketa / anidavatan svaDaya tadekan tasnadDanyana para kincanasa (r.san. 8.7.17) iti / aniditi pranakarnopadanatpragutpate santaniva pranan sucayati / tasnadaja prana iti jayate kasyacinati / tanatidesenapanudati / anicCabdo pi na pragutpate pranasadBavan sucayati / avataniti visesanat / aprano hyanana suBra iti ca nulaprakrte pranadisanastavisesarahitatvasya darsitatvat / tasnatkaranasadBavapradarsanarTa evayananicCabda iti / sresWa iti ca nuKyan prananaBidaDati- prano vava jyesWasca sresWasca (Ca. 5.1.1) iti srutinirdesat / jyesWasca prana sukranisekakaladaraBya tasya vrtilaBat / na cetasya tadanin vrtilaBa syadyonO nisiktan sukran puyeta na sanBavedva / srotradinan tu karnasaskulyadisTanaviBaganispatO vrtilaBana jyesWatvan / sresWasca prano gunaDikyat, na vE saksyanastvadrte jivitun (br. 6.1.13) iti srute / 8 / Pn: tarhi tada pralayakale nrtyurnarako nrtyunatkaryan va nasit, anrtan devaBogyan nasit, ratrya praketascihnarupascandra aha praketa suryasca nastan, svaDaya pitrdeyagnena saha, anit ceswan krtavat / 5 vayukriyaDikaranan / su. 9-12 na vayukriye prTagupadesat
ck: nukyasca prana itarapranavatprahnavikara ityatitisati / tacavisesenEva sarvaprananan prahnavikaratvanakyatan / etasnacayate prano nana sarventriyani ca (nunta. 2.1.3) iti sentriyananovyatirekena pranasyotpatisravanat / sa prananasrcata (pra. 6.4) ityati sravanepyasca / kinarta punaratitesa, atikasankapakaranarta / nasatasiye hi prahnapratane sukte nantravarno pavati na nrtyurasitanrtan na tarhi na ratrya ahnu asitpraketa / anitavatan svataya tatekan tasnatanyana para kincanasa (r.san. 8.7.17) iti / anititi pranakarnopatanatprakutpate santaniva pranan sucayati / tasnataca prana iti cayate kasyacinati / tanatitesenapanutati / anicapto pi na prakutpate pranasatpavan sucayati / avataniti visesanat / aprano hyanana supra iti ca nulaprakrte pranatisanastavisesarahitatvasya tarsitatvat / tasnatkaranasatpavapratarsanarta evayananicapta iti / sresta iti ca nukyan prananapitatati- prano vava cyestasca srestasca (ca. 5.1.1) iti srutinirtesat / cyestasca prana sukranisekakalatarapya tasya vrtilapat / na cetasya tatanin vrtilapa syatyonO nisiktan sukran puyeta na sanpavetva / srotratinan tu karnasaskulyatistanavipakanispatO vrtilapana cyestatvan / srestasca prano kunatikyat, na vE saksyanastvatrte civitun (pr. 6.1.13) iti srute / 8 / pn: tarhi tata pralayakale nrtyurnarako nrtyunatkaryan va nasit, anrtan tevapokyan nasit, ratrya praketascihnarupascantra aha praketa suryasca nastan, svataya pitrteyaknena saha, anit cestan krtavat / 5 vayukriyatikaranan / su. 9-12 na vayukriye prtakupatesat
s: मुख्यश्च प्राण इतरप्राणवद्ब्रह्मविकार इत्यतिदिशति / तच्चाविसेषेणैव सर्वप्राणानां ब्रह्मविकारत्वमाख्यातम् / ऽएतस्माज्जायते प्राणो मनः सर्वेन्

pk: sa punarnuKya prana kinsvarupa itidanin jijnasyate / tatra praptan tavacCrutervayu prana iti / evan hi sruyate- ya prana sa vayu sa esa vayu pancaviDa prano pano vyana udana sanana iti / aTava tantrantariyaBiprayatsanastakaranavrti prana iti praptan / evan hi tantrantariya acaksate- sananya karanavrti pranadya vayava pance ti / atrocyate- na vayu prano napi karanavyapara / kuta - prTagupadesat / vayostavatpranasya prTagupadeso Bavati- prana eva brahnanascascaturTa pada sa vayuna jyotisa Bati ca tapati ca (Cando. 3.18.4) iti / nahi vayureva san vayo prTagupadisyeta / taTa karanavrterapi prTagupadeso Bavati, vagadini karananyanukranya tatra tatra prTakpranasyanukrananat / vrtivrtinatoscaBedat / nahi karanavyapara eva san karaneBya prTagupadisyeta / taTa etasnajayate prano nana sarvendriyani ca / Kan vayu (nu. 2.1.3) ityevanadayo pi vayo karaneByasca pranasya prTagupadesa anusartavya / naca sanastanan karanananeka vrti sanBavati, pratyekanekEkavrtitvatsanudayasya cakarakatvat / nanu panjaracalananyayenEtadBavisyati / yaTEtapanjaravartina ekadasapaksina pratyekan pratiniyatavyapara santa sanBuyEkan panjaran calayanti, evanekasariravartina ekadasa prana pratyekan pratiniyatavrtaya santa sanBuyEkan pranaKyan vrtin pratilapsyanta iti / netyucyate / yuktan tatra pratyekavrtiBiravantaravyaparE panjaracalananurupErevopeta paksina sanBuyEkan panjaran calayeyuriti / taTa drswatvat / iha tu sravanadyavantaravyaparopeta prana na sanBuya pranyuriti yuktan, prananaBavat / atyantavijatiyatvaca sravanadiBya prananasya / taTa pranasya sresWatvadyudGosanan gunaBavopaganasca tan prati vagadinan, na karanavrtinatre prane vakalpate / tasnadanyo vayukriyaByan prana / kaTan tarhiyan sruti ya prana sa vayu iti / ucyate- vayurevayanaDyatnanapana pancavyuho visesatnanavatisWanana prano nana Banyate na tatvantaran napi vayunatran / atascoBe api BedaBedasruti na viruDyete / 9 / syadetat / prano pi tarhi jivavadasninsarire svatantryan prapnoti / sresWatvadgunaBavopaganaca tan prati vagadinanindriyanan / taTahyanekaviDa viButi pranasya sravyate- suptesu vagadisu prana eko hi jagarti prana eko nrtyunanapta prana sanvargo vagadinsanvrn kte prana itaranprananraksati nateva putran iti / tasnatpranasyapi jivavatsvatantryaprasanga / tan pariharati- caksuradivat tu tatsahasiswyadiBya

prtakupatesat / vayostavatpranasya prtakupateso pavati- prana eva prahnanascascaturta pata sa vayuna cyotisa pati ca tapati ca (canto. 3.18.4) iti / nahi vayureva san vayo prtakupatisyeta / tata karanavrterapi prtakupateso pavati, vakatini karananyanukranya tatra tatra prtakpranasyanukrananat / vrtivrtinatoscapetat / nahi karanavyapara eva san karanepya prtakupatisyeta / tata etasnacayate prano nana sarventriyani ca / kan vayu (nu. 2.1.3) ityevanatayo pi vayo karanepyasca pranasya prtakupatesa anusartavya / naca sanastanan karanananeka vrti sanpavati, pratyekanekEkavrtitvatsanutayasya cakarakatvat / nanu pancaracalananyayenEtatpavisyati / yatEtapancaravartina ekatasapaksina pratyekan pratiniyatavyapara santa sanpuyEkan pancaran calayanti, evanekasariravartina ekatasa prana pratyekan pratiniyatavrtaya santa sanpuyEkan pranakyan vrtin pratilapsyanta iti / netyucyate / yuktan tatra pratyekavrtipiravantaravyaparE pancaracalananurupErevopeta paksina sanpuyEkan pancaran calayeyuriti / tata trstatvat / iha tu sravanatyavantaravyaparopeta prana na sanpuya pranyuriti yuktan, prananapavat / atyantavicatiyatvaca sravanatipya prananasya / tata pranasya srestatvatyutkosanan kunapavopakanasca tan prati vakatinan, na karanavrtinatre prane vakalpate / tasnatanyo vayukriyapyan prana / katan tarhiyan sruti ya prana sa vayu iti / ucyate- vayurevayanatyatnanapana pancavyuho visesatnanavatistanana prano nana panyate na tatvantaran napi vayunatran / atascope api petapetasruti na virutyete / 9 / syatetat / prano pi tarhi civavatasninsarire svatantryan prapnoti / srestatvatkunapavopakanaca tan prati vakatinanintriyanan / tatahyanekavita viputi pranasya sravyate- suptesu vakatisu prana eko hi cakarti prana eko nrtyunanapta prana sanvarko vakatinsanvrn kte prana itaranprananraksati nateva putran iti / tasnatpranasyapi civavatsvatantryaprasanka / tan pariharati- caksurativat tu tatsahasistyatipya

pk: tusabda pranasya jivavatsvatantryan vyavartayati / yaTa caksuradini rajaprakrtivajivasya kartrtvan Boktrtvan ca pratyupakaranani na svatantrani / taTa nuKyo pi prano rajanantrivajivasya sarvarTakaratvenopakaranaButo na svatantra / kuta / tatsahasiswyadiBya / tEscaksuradiBi sahEva prana sisyate pranasanvadadisu / sananaDarnanan ca saha sasanan yuktan brhadraTantaradivat / adisabdena sanhatatvacetanatvadinpranasya svatantryanirakaranahetundarsati / 10 / syadetat / yadi caksuradivatpranasya jivan prati karanaBavo Bayupaganyeta,visayantaran rupadivatprasajyeta / rupadyalocanadiBirvrtiBiryaTasvan caksuradinan jivan prati karanaBavo Bavati / apicEkadasEva karyajatani rupalocanadini pariganitani yadarTanekadasa prana sangrhita natu dvadasanaparan karyajatanaDiganyate yadarTanayan dvadasa prana pratijnayeteti / ata utaran paWati- akaranatvac ca na dosas taTa hi darsayati
ck: tusapta pranasya civavatsvatantryan vyavartayati / yata caksuratini racaprakrtivacivasya kartrtvan poktrtvan ca pratyupakaranani na svatantrani / tata nukyo pi prano racanantrivacivasya sarvartakaratvenopakaranaputo na svatantra / kuta / tatsahasistyatipya / tEscaksuratipi sahEva prana sisyate pranasanvatatisu / sananatarnanan ca saha sasanan yuktan prhatratantarativat / atisaptena sanhatatvacetanatvatinpranasya svatantryanirakaranahetuntarsati / 10 / syatetat / yati caksurativatpranasya civan prati karanapavo payupakanyeta,visayantaran rupativatprasacyeta / rupatyalocanatipirvrtipiryatasvan caksuratinan civan prati karanapavo pavati / apicEkatasEva karyacatani rupalocanatini parikanitani yatartanekatasa prana sankrhita natu tvatasanaparan karyacatanatikanyate yatartanayan tvatasa prana praticnayeteti / ata utaran patati- akaranatvac ca na tosas tata hi tarsayati

pk: na tavadvisayantaraprasango dosa / akaranatvatpranasya / nahi caksuradivatpranasya visayaparicCedena karanatvanaByupaganyate / nacasyEtavata karyaBava eva / kasnat / taTahi sruti pranantaresvasanBavyananan nuKyapranasya vEsesikan karyan darsayati pranasanvadadisu- aTa ha prana ahansreyasi vyudire ityupakranya yasninva utkrante sariran papisWataraniva drsyate sa va sresWa (Ca. 5.1.6,7) iti copanyasya pratyekan vagadyutkrananena tadvrtinatrahinan yaTapurvan jivanan darsayitva pranocikranisayan vagadisETilyapatin sarirapataprasangan ca darsayanti sruti prananinitan sarirendriyasTitin darsayati / tavanvarisWa prana uvaca na nohanapadyaTahanevEtatpancaDatnanan praviBajyEtadbananavaswaBya viDarayani, iti cEtanevarTan srutiraha- pranena raksanavaran kulayan (br. 4.3.12) iti ca suptesu caksuradisu prananinitan sariraraksan darsayati / yasnatkasnacangatprana utkranati tadEva tacCusyati (br. 1.3.19) / tena yadasnati yatpibati tenetaranprananavati iti ca prananinitan sarirendriyapuswin darsayati / kasninvahanutkranta utkranto Bavisyani kasninva pratisWite pratisWasyani iti, sa prananasrjata iti ca prananinite jivasyotkrantapratisWe darsayati / 1 / Pn: ahansreyasi svasya sresWataninitan, vyudire vivadan cakrire / aparan nican, kulayan dehaKyan grhan / pancavrtir nanovat vyapadisyate
ck: na tavatvisayantaraprasanko tosa / akaranatvatpranasya / nahi caksurativatpranasya visayaparicetena karanatvanapyupakanyate / nacasyEtavata karyapava eva / kasnat / tatahi sruti pranantaresvasanpavyananan nukyapranasya vEsesikan karyan tarsayati pranasanvatatisu- ata ha prana ahansreyasi vyutire ityupakranya yasninva utkrante sariran papistataraniva trsyate sa va sresta (ca. 5.1.6,7) iti copanyasya pratyekan vakatyutkrananena tatvrtinatrahinan yatapurvan civanan tarsayitva pranocikranisayan vakatisEtilyapatin sarirapataprasankan ca tarsayanti sruti prananinitan sarirentriyastitin tarsayati / tavanvarista prana uvaca na nohanapatyatahanevEtatpancatatnanan pravipacyEtatpananavastapya vitarayani, iti cEtanevartan srutiraha- pranena raksanavaran kulayan (pr. 4.3.12) iti ca suptesu caksuratisu prananinitan sariraraksan tarsayati / yasnatkasnacankatprana utkranati tatEva tacusyati (pr. 1.3.19) / tena yatasnati yatpipati tenetaranprananavati iti ca prananinitan sarirentriyapustin tarsayati / kasninvahanutkranta utkranto pavisyani kasninva pratistite pratistasyani iti, sa prananasrcata iti ca prananinite civasyotkrantapratiste tarsayati / 1 / pn: ahansreyasi svasya srestataninitan, vyutire vivatan cakrire / aparan nican, kulayan tehakyan krhan / pancavrtir nanovat vyapatisyate
s: न तावद्विषयान्तरप्रसङ्गो दोषः / अकरणत्वात्प्राणस्य / नहि चक्षुरादिवत्प्राणस्य विषयपरिच्छेदेन करणत्वमभ्युपगम्यते / नचास्यैतावता कार्याभाव एव

pk: itascasti nuKyasya pranasya vEsesikan karyan, yatkaranan pancavrtirayan vyapadisyate srutisu prano pano vyana udana sanana (br. 1.5.3) iti / vrtiBedascayan karyaBedapeksa / prana pragvrtirucCvasadikarna / apanorvagvrtirnisvasadikarna / vyanastayo sanDO vartanano viryavatkarnahetu / udana urDvavrtirutkrantyadihetu / sanana sanan sarvesvangesu yo narasanayatiti / evan pancavrti prano nanovat / yaTa nanasa panca vrtaya evan pranasyapityarTa / srotradininita sabdadivisaya nanasa panca vrtaya prasidDa, natu kana sankalpa ityadya paripaWita parigrhyeran / pancasanKyatirekat / nanvatrapi srotradinirapeksa ButaBavisyadadivisayapara nanaso vrtirastiti sanana pancasanKyatireka / evan tarhi paranatanapratisidDananunatan Bavati iti nyayadihapi yogasastraprasidDa nanasa pancavrtaya parigrhyante prananaviparyayavikalpanidrasnrtaya (pata. yoga. su. 1.1.6) nana / bahuvrtitvanatrena va nana pranasya nidarsananiti draswavyan / jivopakaranatvanapi pranasya pancavrtitvananovaditi yojayitavyan / 12 / Pn: prananan praniti, viparyayo Brana, sabdajnananupati vastusunyo vikalpa, tanasi vrtirnidra / 6 sresWanutvaDikaranan / su. 13 anus ca
ck: itascasti nukyasya pranasya vEsesikan karyan, yatkaranan pancavrtirayan vyapatisyate srutisu prano pano vyana utana sanana (pr. 1.5.3) iti / vrtipetascayan karyapetapeksa / prana prakvrtirucvasatikarna / apanorvakvrtirnisvasatikarna / vyanastayo santO vartanano viryavatkarnahetu / utana urtvavrtirutkrantyatihetu / sanana sanan sarvesvankesu yo narasanayatiti / evan pancavrti prano nanovat / yata nanasa panca vrtaya evan pranasyapityarta / srotratininita saptativisaya nanasa panca vrtaya prasita, natu kana sankalpa ityatya paripatita parikrhyeran / pancasankyatirekat / nanvatrapi srotratinirapeksa putapavisyatativisayapara nanaso vrtirastiti sanana pancasankyatireka / evan tarhi paranatanapratisitananunatan pavati iti nyayatihapi yokasastraprasita nanasa pancavrtaya parikrhyante prananaviparyayavikalpanitrasnrtaya (pata. yoka. su. 1.1.6) nana / pahuvrtitvanatrena va nana pranasya nitarsananiti trastavyan / civopakaranatvanapi pranasya pancavrtitvananovatiti yocayitavyan / 12 / pn: prananan praniti, viparyayo prana, saptacnananupati vastusunyo vikalpa, tanasi vrtirnitra / 6 srestanutvatikaranan / su. 13 anus ca

ck: anuscayan nukya prana pratyetavya itarapranavat / anutvan cehapi sOksnyaparicetO na parananutulyatvan / pancapirvrtipi krtsnasariravyapitvat / suksna prana utkrantO parsvastenanupalapyananatvat / paricinascotkrantikatyakatisrutipya / nanu viputvanapi pranasya sananayate- sana plusina sano nasakena sano nakena sana epistripirlokE sano nena sarvena (pr. 1.3.2) ityevanatipratesesu / tatucyate- atitEvikena sanastivyastirupena hEranyakarnena pranatnanEvEtatviputvananayate natyatnikena / apica sana plusinetyatina sanyavacanena pratipranivartina pranasya pariceta eva pratarsyate tasnatatosa / 13 / pn: plusirnasakatapi suksno cantu, nako hasti / 7 cyotiratyatikaranan / su. 14-16 cyotiratyatistanan tu tatanananat
s: अणुश्चायं मुख्यः प्राणः प्रत्येतव्य इतरप्राणवत् / अणुत्वं चेहापि सौक्ष्म्यपरिच्छेदौ न परमाणुतुल्यत्वम् / पञ्चभिर्वृत्तिभिः कृत्स्नशरीरव्यापि

pk: te puna prakrta prana kin svanahinEva svasnE karyaya praBavantyahosvidevataDisWita praBavantiti vicaryate- tatra praptan tavadyaTa svakaryasaktiyogatsvanahinEva prana pravarteraniti / apica devataDisWitanan prananan pravrtavaByupaganyananayan tasanevaDisWatrinan devatanan BoktrtvaprasangacCarirasya Boktrtvan praliyeta / ata svanahinEvEsan pravrtiriti / evan praptan idanucyate- jyotiradyaDisWanan tu iti / tusabdena purvapakso vyavartyate / jyotiradiBiragnyadyaBinaniniBirdevataBiraDisWitan vagadi karanajatan svakaryesu pravartata iti pratijanite / hetun vyacaswe- tadanananaditi / taTahyanananti- agnirvagButva nuKan pravisat (Eta. 2.4) ityadi / agnescayan vagBavo nuKapravesasca devatatnanaDisWatrtvanangikrtyocyate / nahi devatasanbanDan pratyaKyayagnervaci nuKe va kascidvisesasanbanDo drsyate / taTa vayu prano Butva nasike pravisat (Eta. 2.4) ityevanadyapi yOjayitavyan / taTanyatrapi vageva brahnanascaturTa pada so gnina jyotisa Bati ca tapati ca (Ca. 3.18.3) ityevanadina vagadinanagnyadijyotiswvadivacanenEtanevarTan draQayati / sa vE vacaneva praTananatyavahatsa yada nrtyunatyanucyata so gniraBavat (br. 1.3.12) iti cEvanadina vagadinanagnyadiBavapativacanenEtanevarTan dyotayati / sarvatra caDyatnaDidEvataviBagena vagadyagnyadyanukrananananayEva pratyasatya Bavati / sanrtavapi- vagaDyatnaniti prahurbrahnanastatvadarsina / vaktavyanaDiButan tu vahnistatraDidEvacatan / ityadina vagadinanagnyadidevataDisWitatvan saprapancan darsitan / yaduktan svakaryasaktiyogatsvanahinEva prana pravarteraniti / tadayuktan / saktananapi sakawadinananaqudadyaDisWitanan pravrtidarsanat / uBayaTopapatO caganadevataDisWitatvaneva nisciyate / 14 / Pn: Bati dipyate / tapati svakaryan karoti / sa prano vacan praTananudgiTakarnani praDanan anrtadipapnarupan nrtyunatityavahanrtyuna nuktan krtva agnidevatatnatvan prapitavan / yadapyuktan devatananevaDisWatrinan Boktrtvaprasango na sarirasyeti tatparihriyate- pranavata sabdat
ck: te puna prakrta prana kin svanahinEva svasnE karyaya prapavantyahosvitevatatistita prapavantiti vicaryate- tatra praptan tavatyata svakaryasaktiyokatsvanahinEva prana pravarteraniti / apica tevatatistitanan prananan pravrtavapyupakanyananayan tasanevatistatrinan tevatanan poktrtvaprasankacarirasya poktrtvan praliyeta / ata svanahinEvEsan pravrtiriti / evan praptan itanucyate- cyotiratyatistanan tu iti / tusaptena purvapakso vyavartyate / cyotiratipiraknyatyapinaninipirtevatapiratistitan vakati karanacatan svakaryesu pravartata iti praticanite / hetun vyacaste- tatanananatiti / tatahyanananti- aknirvakputva nukan pravisat (Eta. 2.4) ityati / aknescayan vakpavo nukapravesasca tevatatnanatistatrtvanankikrtyocyate / nahi tevatasanpantan pratyakyayaknervaci nuke va kascitvisesasanpanto trsyate / tata vayu prano putva nasike pravisat (Eta. 2.4) ityevanatyapi yOcayitavyan / tatanyatrapi vakeva prahnanascaturta pata so knina cyotisa pati ca tapati ca (ca. 3.18.3) ityevanatina vakatinanaknyaticyotistvativacanenEtanevartan tratayati / sa vE vacaneva pratananatyavahatsa yata nrtyunatyanucyata so knirapavat (pr. 1.3.12) iti cEvanatina vakatinanaknyatipavapativacanenEtanevartan tyotayati / sarvatra catyatnatitEvatavipakena vakatyaknyatyanukrananananayEva pratyasatya pavati / sanrtavapi- vakatyatnaniti prahurprahnanastatvatarsina / vaktavyanatiputan tu vahnistatratitEvacatan / ityatina vakatinanaknyatitevatatistitatvan saprapancan tarsitan / yatuktan svakaryasaktiyokatsvanahinEva prana pravarteraniti / tatayuktan / saktananapi sakatatinananatutatyatistitanan pravrtitarsanat / upayatopapatO cakanatevatatistitatvaneva nisciyate / 14 / pn: pati tipyate / tapati svakaryan karoti / sa prano vacan pratananutkitakarnani pratanan anrtatipapnarupan nrtyunatityavahanrtyuna nuktan krtva aknitevatatnatvan prapitavan / yatapyuktan tevatananevatistatrinan poktrtvaprasanko na sarirasyeti tatparihriyate- pranavata saptat

pk: satisvapi pranananaDiswatrisu devatasu pranavata karyakaranasanGatasvanina sarirenEvEsan prananan sanbanDa sruteravaganyate / taTahi sruti - aTa yatrEtadakasananuvisanan caksu sa caksusa puruso darsanaya taksuraTa yo vededan jiGraniti sa atna ganDaya Granan (Ca. 8.124) ityevanjatiyaka sarirenEva prananan sanbanDan sravayati / apicanekatvatpratikarananaDisWatrinan devatanan na Boktrtvanasninsarire vakalpate / eko hyevanasninsarire sariro Bokta pratisanDanadisanBavadavaganyate / 15 / Pn: aTa dehe pragapravesanantaran yatra golake etacCidrananupraviswan caksurindriyan tatra caksusyaBinani sa atna caksusa tasya rupadarsanaya caksu / tasya ca nityatvat
ck: satisvapi pranananatistatrisu tevatasu pranavata karyakaranasankatasvanina sarirenEvEsan prananan sanpanta sruteravakanyate / tatahi sruti - ata yatrEtatakasananuvisanan caksu sa caksusa puruso tarsanaya taksurata yo vetetan cikraniti sa atna kantaya kranan (ca. 8.124) ityevancatiyaka sarirenEva prananan sanpantan sravayati / apicanekatvatpratikarananatistatrinan tevatanan na poktrtvanasninsarire vakalpate / eko hyevanasninsarire sariro pokta pratisantanatisanpavatavakanyate / 15 / pn: ata tehe prakapravesanantaran yatra kolake etacitrananupravistan caksurintriyan tatra caksusyapinani sa atna caksusa tasya rupatarsanaya caksu / tasya ca nityatvat

pk: syadetat / kaTan puna pancanyanahutavapa purusavacaso Bavanti (Ca. 5.3.3) ityetanirDarayitun paryate / yavata nEva praTane gnavapan sravananasti / iha hi dyulokapraBrtaya pancagnaya pancananahutinanadaratvenaDita / tesan ca pranuKe asO vava loko gOtanagni (Ca. 5.4.1) ityupakranya tasninetasninagnO deva sradDan juhvati (Ca. 5.4.2) iti sradDa hOnyadravyatvenavedita / na tatrapo hOnyadravyataya sruta / yadi nana parjanyadisutaresu catursvagnisvapan hOnyadravyata parikalpyeta parikalpyatan nana / tesu hotavyatayopatanan sonadinanabahulatvopapate / praTane tvagnO srutan sradDan parityajyasruta apa parikalpyanta iti sahasanetat / sradDa ca nana pratyayavisesa prasidDisanarTyat / tasnadayukta pancanyahutavapan purusaBava iti cet / nEsa dosa / yatastatrapi praTane gnO ta evapa sradDasabdenaBipreyante / kuta upapate / evanhyadinaDyavasanasanganadanakulanetadekavakyanupapadyate / itaraTa puna pancanyanahutavapan purusavacastvaprakare prswe prativacanavasare praTanahutisTane yadyanapo hOnyadravyan sradDan nanavatarayetato nyaTa prasno nyaTa prativacananityekavakyata na syat / iti tu pancanyanahutavapa purusavacaso Bavanti iti copasanharanetadeva darsayati / sradDakaryan ca sonavrswyadi sTuliBavadabahulan laksyate / sa ca sradDaya aptve yukti / karananurupan hi karyan Bavati / naca sradDaKya pratyayo nanaso jivasya va Darna sanDarnino niskrsya honayosadatun sakyate pasvadiBya iva hrdayadinityapa eva sradDasabda Baveyu / sradDasabdascapsupapadyate, vEdikaprayogadarsanat sradDa va apa iti / tanutvan sradDasarupyan gacCantya apo dehabijaButa ityata sradDasabda syu / yaTa sinhaparakrano nara sinhasabdo Bavati / sradDapurvakakarnasanavayacapsu sradDasabda upapadyate, nancasabda iva purusesu / sradDahetutvaca sradDasabdopapati apo hasnE sradDan sananante punyaya karnane iti srute / 5 / Pn: sanganan tanutkranantanityadO / anapa abdyo nyata / asnE yajananaya / sananante janayanti / asrutatvad iti cen neswadikarinan pratite
ck: syatetat / katan puna pancanyanahutavapa purusavacaso pavanti (ca. 5.3.3) ityetanirtarayitun paryate / yavata nEva pratane knavapan sravananasti / iha hi tyulokapraprtaya pancaknaya pancananahutinanataratvenatita / tesan ca pranuke asO vava loko kOtanakni (ca. 5.4.1) ityupakranya tasninetasninaknO teva sratan cuhvati (ca. 5.4.2) iti srata hOnyatravyatvenavetita / na tatrapo hOnyatravyataya sruta / yati nana parcanyatisutaresu catursvaknisvapan hOnyatravyata parikalpyeta parikalpyatan nana / tesu hotavyatayopatanan sonatinanapahulatvopapate / pratane tvaknO srutan sratan parityacyasruta apa parikalpyanta iti sahasanetat / srata ca nana pratyayavisesa prasitisanartyat / tasnatayukta pancanyahutavapan purusapava iti cet / nEsa tosa / yatastatrapi pratane knO ta evapa sratasaptenapipreyante / kuta upapate / evanhyatinatyavasanasankanatanakulanetatekavakyanupapatyate / itarata puna pancanyanahutavapan purusavacastvaprakare prste prativacanavasare pratanahutistane yatyanapo hOnyatravyan sratan nanavatarayetato nyata prasno nyata prativacananityekavakyata na syat / iti tu pancanyanahutavapa purusavacaso pavanti iti copasanharanetateva tarsayati / sratakaryan ca sonavrstyati stulipavatapahulan laksyate / sa ca srataya aptve yukti / karananurupan hi karyan pavati / naca sratakya pratyayo nanaso civasya va tarna santarnino niskrsya honayosatatun sakyate pasvatipya iva hrtayatinityapa eva sratasapta paveyu / sratasaptascapsupapatyate, vEtikaprayokatarsanat srata va apa iti / tanutvan sratasarupyan kacantya apo tehapicaputa ityata sratasapta syu / yata sinhaparakrano nara sinhasapto pavati / sratapurvakakarnasanavayacapsu sratasapta upapatyate, nancasapta iva purusesu / sratahetutvaca sratasaptopapati apo hasnE sratan sananante punyaya karnane iti srute / 5 / pn: sankanan tanutkranantanityatO / anapa aptyo nyata / asnE yacananaya / sananante canayanti / asrutatvat iti cen nestatikarinan pratite
s: स्यादेतत् / कथं पुनः ऽपञ्चम्यामाहुतावापः पुरुषवचसो भवन्तिऽ (छा. ५.३.३) इत्येतन्निर्धारयितुं पार्यते / यावता नैव प्रथमे ऽग्नावपां श्रवणमस्ति

pk: aTapi syatprativacanaByan nanapa sradDadikranena pancanyanahutO purusakaran pratipadyeran / natu tatsanparisvakta jiva ranheyu / asrutatvat / nahyatrapaniva jivanan sravayita kascicCabdo sti / tasnadranhati sanparisvakta ityayuktaniti cet / nEsa dosa / kuta - iswadikarinan pratite / aTa ya ine grana iswapurte datanityupasate te DunanaBisanBavanti (Ca. 5.10.6) ityupakranyeswadikarinan Dunadina pitryanena paTa candrapraptin kaTayati- akasacandranasanesa sono raja (Ca. 5.10.4) iti / ta evehapi pratiyante tasninetasninagnO deva sradDan juhvati tasya ahute sono raja sanBavati (Ca. 5.4.2) iti srutisananyat / tesan cagnihotradarsapurnanasadikarnasaDanaButa daDipayapraBrtayo dravadravyaBuyastvatpratyaksanevapa santi / tan ahavaniye huta suksna ahutyo purvarupa satyastaniswadikarina asrayanti / tesan ca sariran nEDanena viDanenantye gravrtvijo juhvati asO svargaya lokaya svaha iti / tatasta sradDapurvakakarnasanavayinya ahutinaya apo purvarupa satyastaniswadikarino jivanpariveswayanun lokan Paladanaya nayantiti yatadatra juhotinaBiDiyate- sradDan juhvati (br. 6.2.9) iti / taTacagnihotre sawprasninirvacanarupena vakyasesena te va ete ahuti hute utkranata ityevanadinagnihotrahutyo PalaranBaya lokantaraprapti pradarsita / tasnadahutinayiBiradBi sanparisvakta jiva ranhanti svakarnaPalopaBogayeti slisyate / 6 / Pn: nEDanena antyeswyaKyena / asO svargaya gacCatviti nantrarTa / kaTan punaridaniswadikarinan svakarnaPalopaBogaya ranhanan pratijnayate / yavata tesan Dunapratikena vartnana candranasanaDiruQanananaBavan darsayati- esa sono raja tadevanananan te deva Baksayanti (Ca. 5.10.4) iti te candran prapyanan Bavanti tanstatra deva yaTa sonan rajananapyayasvapaksiyasvetyevanenanstatra Baksayanti (br. 6.2.16) iti ca sananavisayan srutyantaran / naca vyaGradiBiriva devErBaksyananananupaBoga sanBavatiti / ata utaran paWati- Baktan vanatnavitvat taTa hi darsayati
ck: atapi syatprativacanapyan nanapa sratatikranena pancanyanahutO purusakaran pratipatyeran / natu tatsanparisvakta civa ranheyu / asrutatvat / nahyatrapaniva civanan sravayita kascicapto sti / tasnatranhati sanparisvakta ityayuktaniti cet / nEsa tosa / kuta - istatikarinan pratite / ata ya ine krana istapurte tatanityupasate te tunanapisanpavanti (ca. 5.10.6) ityupakranyestatikarinan tunatina pitryanena pata cantrapraptin katayati- akasacantranasanesa sono raca (ca. 5.10.4) iti / ta evehapi pratiyante tasninetasninaknO teva sratan cuhvati tasya ahute sono raca sanpavati (ca. 5.4.2) iti srutisananyat / tesan caknihotratarsapurnanasatikarnasatanaputa tatipayapraprtayo travatravyapuyastvatpratyaksanevapa santi / tan ahavaniye huta suksna ahutyo purvarupa satyastanistatikarina asrayanti / tesan ca sariran nEtanena vitanenantye kravrtvico cuhvati asO svarkaya lokaya svaha iti / tatasta sratapurvakakarnasanavayinya ahutinaya apo purvarupa satyastanistatikarino civanparivestayanun lokan palatanaya nayantiti yatatatra cuhotinapitiyate- sratan cuhvati (pr. 6.2.9) iti / tatacaknihotre satprasninirvacanarupena vakyasesena te va ete ahuti hute utkranata ityevanatinaknihotrahutyo palaranpaya lokantaraprapti pratarsita / tasnatahutinayipiratpi sanparisvakta civa ranhanti svakarnapalopapokayeti slisyate / 6 / pn: nEtanena antyestyakyena / asO svarkaya kacatviti nantrarta / katan punaritanistatikarinan svakarnapalopapokaya ranhanan praticnayate / yavata tesan tunapratikena vartnana cantranasanatirutanananapavan tarsayati- esa sono raca tatevanananan te teva paksayanti (ca. 5.10.4) iti te cantran prapyanan pavanti tanstatra teva yata sonan racananapyayasvapaksiyasvetyevanenanstatra paksayanti (pr. 6.2.16) iti ca sananavisayan srutyantaran / naca vyakratipiriva tevErpaksyananananupapoka sanpavatiti / ata utaran patati- paktan vanatnavitvat tata hi tarsayati

ck: pancaknivityayan veta yatasO loko na sanpuryate (ca. 5.3.3) ityasya prasnasya prativacanavasare sruyate- atEtayo patorna katarenacana taninani ksutranyasakrtavartini putani pavanti / cayasva nriyasvetyetatrtiyan stanan tenasO loko na sanpuryate (ca. 5.10.8) iti / tatrEtayo patoriti vityakarnanorityetat / kasnat / prakrtatvat / vityakarnani hi tevayanapitryanayo pato pratipatO prakrte / tatya itan vitu iti vitya taya pratipatavyo tevayana panta prakirtita / istapurte tatan (ca. 5.10.1,3) iti karna tena pratipatavya pitryana panta prakirtita / tatpakriyayan- atEtayo patorna katarenacana iti srutan / etatuktan pavati- ye na vityasatanena tevayane patyatikrta napi karnana pitryane tesanesa ksutracantulaksano sakrtavarti trtiya panta pavatiti / tasnatapi nanistatikaripiscantrana prapyate / syatetat / te pi cantrapinpanaruhya tato varuhya ksutracantutvan pratipatsyanta iti / tatapi nasti / arohanartakyat / apica sarvesu prayatsu cantralokan prapnuvatsvasO loka prayatpi sanpuryetetyata prasnavirutan prativacanan prasacyeta / tatahi prativacanan tatavyan yatasO loko na sanpuryate / avarohapyupakanatasanpurnopapatiriti cet / na / asrutatvat / satyanavarohatapyasanpurananupapatyate / srutistu trtiyastanasankirtanenasanpuranan tarsayati- etatrtiyan stanan tenasO loko na sanpuryate (ca. 5.10.8) iti / tenanarohatevasanpurananiti yuktan / avarohasyestatikarisvapyavisistatve sati trtiyastanoktyanartakyaprasankat / tusaptastu sakantariyavakyaprapavanasesakananasankanucinati / evan satyatikrtapeksa sakantariye vakye sarvasapto vatistate / ye vE kecitatikrta asnalokatprayanti cantranasaneva te sarve kacantiti / 17 / yatpunaruktan tehalapopapataye sarve cantranasan kantunarhanti, pancanyanahutavityahutisankyaniyanatiti / tatpratyucyate- na trtiye tatopalapte

na tavatupayapratiseta upapatyate sunyavataprasankat / kinciti paranartanalanpyarta pratisityate yata racvatisu sarpataya / taca parisisyanane kasninscitpave vakalpate / upayapratisete tu ko nyo pava parisesyat / aparisisyanane canyasninya itara pratisetunarapyate pratisetunasakyatvatasyEva paranartatvapate pratisetanupapati / napi prahnapratiseta upapatyate prahna te pravani (pr. 2.1.1) ityatyupakranavirotat / asaneva sa pavati / asatprahneti veta cet (tEti. 2.6.1) ityatinintavirotat / astityevopalaptavya (kata. 6.13) ityavataranavirotat / sarvavetantavyakopaprasankaca / vananasatitatvanapi prahnano napavapiprayenapitiyate / nahi nahata parikarapantena prahnavitapnoti paran (tE. 2.1.1), satyan cnanananantan prahna (tE. 2.1.1) ityevanatina vetantesu prahnapratipatya tasyEva punarapavo pilapyeta / praksalanati pan kasya turatasparsan varan iti hi nyaya / pratipatanaprakriya tvesa yato vaco nivartante / aprapya nanasa saha (tE. 2.4.1) iti / etatuktan pavati - vananasatitanavisayantapati pratyakatnaputan nityasutaputanuktasvapavan prahneti / tasnatprahnano rupaprapancan pratisetati parisinasti prahnetyapyupakantavyan / tatetatucyate prakrtEtavatvan hi pratisetatiti / prakrtan yatetavatiyataparicinan nurtanurtalaksanan prahnano ru

pk: yadetanirastasanastaprapancan brahna nirDaritanasnatparananyatatvanasti nastiti srutivipratipate sansaya / kanicidDi vakyanyapatenEva pratiBasananani brahnano pi parananyatatvan pratipadayantiva / tesan hi pariharanaBiDatunayanupakrana kriyate / paranato brahnano nyatatvan Bavitunarhati / kuta - sata sonya tada sanpano Bavati (Ca. 6.8.1) iti sarira atna (tE. 2.3.1) prajnenatnana sanparisvakta (br. 4.3.21) iti ca / nitanan ca nitena sanDo drswo yaTa naranan nagarena / jivanan ca brahnana sanbanDan vyapadisati susuptO / atastata parananyadanitanastiti ganyate / BedavyapadesascEtanevarTan ganayati / taTahi - tasyEtasya tadeva rupan yadanusya rupan yavanusya gesnO yanana tanana (Ca. 1.7.5) iti / savaDikan cesvaratvanuBayorvyapadisati - ye canusnatparanco lokastesan ceswe devakananan ca (Ca. 1.6.8) ityekasya / ye cEtasnadarvanco lokastesan ceswe nanusyakananan ca (Ca. 1.7.6) ityekasya / yaTedan nagaDasya rajyanidan vEdehasyeti / 31 / Pn: vatapracuro deso jangala / evaneteBya setvadivyapadeseByo brahnana paranastityevan prapte pratipadyate - pk: tusabdena pradarsitan praptin nirunadDi / na brahnano nyatkincidBavitunarhati prananaBavat / nahyanyasyastitve kincitpranananupalaBanahe / sarvasya hi janinato vastujatasya janadi brahnano Bavatiti nirDaritan / ananyatvan ca karanatkaryasya / naca brahnavyatiriktan kincidajan sanBavati sadeva sonyedanagra asidekanevadvitiyan (Ca. 6.2.1) ityavaDaranat / ekavijnanena ca sarvavijnanapratijnanana brahnavyatiriktavastvastitvanavakalpate / nu setvadivyapadesa brahnavyatiriktan tatvan sucayantityuktan / netyucyate / setuvyapadesastavana brahnano bahyasya sadBavan pratipadayitun ksanate / seturatneti hyaha na tata paranastiti / tatra parasninasati setutvan navakalpata iti paran kinapi kalpyeta / nacEtanyayan / ajatvadisrutiviroDat / setusananyatu setusabda atnani prayukta iti s lisyate / jagatastanaryadanan ca viDarakatvan setusananyanatnana / ata seturiva seturiti prakrta atna stuyate / setun tirtvetyapi tarateratikranasanBavatprapnotyarTa eva vartate / yaTa vyakaranan tirna iti prapta idanucyate natikrantastadvat / 32 / budDyarTa padavat
ck: tusaptena pratarsitan praptin nirunati / na prahnano nyatkincitpavitunarhati prananapavat / nahyanyasyastitve kincitpranananupalapanahe / sarvasya hi caninato vastucatasya canati prahnano pavatiti nirtaritan / ananyatvan ca karanatkaryasya / naca prahnavyatiriktan kincitacan sanpavati sateva sonyetanakra asitekanevatvitiyan (ca. 6.2.1) ityavataranat / ekavicnanena ca sarvavicnanapraticnanana prahnavyatiriktavastvastitvanavakalpate / nu setvativyapatesa prahnavyatiriktan tatvan sucayantityuktan / netyucyate / setuvyapatesastavana prahnano pahyasya satpavan pratipatayitun ksanate / seturatneti hyaha na tata paranastiti / tatra parasninasati setutvan navakalpata iti paran kinapi kalpyeta / nacEtanyayan / acatvatisrutivirotat / setusananyatu setusapta atnani prayukta iti s lisyate / cakatastanaryatanan ca vitarakatvan setusananyanatnana / ata seturiva seturiti prakrta atna stuyate / setun tirtvetyapi tarateratikranasanpavatprapnotyarta eva vartate / yata vyakaranan tirna iti prapta itanucyate natikrantastatvat / 32 / putyarta patavat
s: तुशब्देन प्रदर्शितां प्राप्तिं निरुणद्धि / न ब्रह्मणो ऽन्यत्किञ्चिद्भवितुमर्हति प्रमाणाभावात् / नह्यन्यस्यास्तित्वे किञ्चित्प्रमाणमुपलभामहे

pk: yadapyuktanunanavyapadesadasti paraniti, tatraBiDiyate - unanavyapadeso pi na brahnavyatiriktavastvastitvapratipatyarTa / kinarTastarhi budDyarTa, upasanarTa iti yavat / catuspadaswasaPan soqasakalanityevanrupa budDi katan nu nana brahnani sTira syaditi vikaradvarena brahnana unanakalpanEva kriyate / nahyavikare nante brahnani sarvE punBi sakya bujadDi sTapayitun nandanaDyanotanabudDitvatpunsaniti / padavat / yaTa nana akasayoraDyatnanaDidEvatan ca brahnapratikayoranatayoscatvaro vagadayo nanasanbanDina pada kalpyante catvarascagnyadaya akasasanbanDina aDyanaya tadvat / aTava padavaditi yaTa karsapane padaviBago vyavaharapracuryaya kalpyate / nahi sakalenEva karsapanena sarvada sarve jana vyavahartunisate krayavikraye parinananiyanatadvadityarTa / 3 / Pn: brahnana unanakalpanan nandaDiyan Dyanavyavaharaya karsapanasya padavyavaharat / sTanavisesatprakasadivat
ck: yatapyuktanunanavyapatesatasti paraniti, tatrapitiyate - unanavyapateso pi na prahnavyatiriktavastvastitvapratipatyarta / kinartastarhi putyarta, upasanarta iti yavat / catuspatastasapan sotasakalanityevanrupa puti katan nu nana prahnani stira syatiti vikaratvarena prahnana unanakalpanEva kriyate / nahyavikare nante prahnani sarvE punpi sakya pucati stapayitun nantanatyanotanaputitvatpunsaniti / patavat / yata nana akasayoratyatnanatitEvatan ca prahnapratikayoranatayoscatvaro vakatayo nanasanpantina pata kalpyante catvarascaknyataya akasasanpantina atyanaya tatvat / atava patavatiti yata karsapane patavipako vyavaharapracuryaya kalpyate / nahi sakalenEva karsapanena sarvata sarve cana vyavahartunisate krayavikraye parinananiyanatatvatityarta / 3 / pn: prahnana unanakalpanan nantatiyan tyanavyavaharaya karsapanasya patavyavaharat / stanavisesatprakasativat
s: यदप्युक्तमुन्मानव्यपदेशादस्ति परमिति, तत्राभिधीयते - उन्मानव्यपदेशो ऽपि न ब्रह्मव्यतिरिक्तवस्त्वस्तित्वप्रतिपत्त्यर्थः / किमर्थस्तर्हि बुद्ध

ck: iha sutre tvayorapi sanpantapetavyatesayo pariharo vitiyate / yatapyuktan sanpantavyapatesatpetavyapatesaca paranata syatiti tatapyasat / yata ekasyapi stanavisesapeksayEtO vyapatesavupapatyate / sanpantavyapatese tavatayanarta / putyatyupatistanavisesayokatutputasya visesavicnanasyopatyupasane ya upasana sa paranatnana sanapanta ityupatyapeksayEvopacaryate na parinititvapeksaya / tata petavyapateso pi prahnana upatipetapeksayopacaryate na svarupapetapeksaya prakasativatityupanopatanat / yatEkasya prakasasya sOryasya cantranasasya vopatiyokatupacatavisesasyopatyupasanatsanpantavyapateso pavatyupatipetaca petavyapatesa / yatava sucipasakasatisupatyapeksayEvEtO sanpantapetavyapatesO pavatastatvat / 34 / upapates ca

pk: upapadyate catredrsa eva sanbanDo nanyadrsa svanapito Bavati (Ca. 6.8.1) iti hi svarupasanbanDanenananananti svarupasya canapayitvat / na naranagaranyayena sanbanDo Gawate / upaDikrtasvarupatiroBavatu - svanapito Bavati (Ca. 6.8.1) ityupapadyate / taTa Bedo pi nanyadrsa sanBavati / bahutarasrutiprasidDEkesvaratvaviroDat / taTaca srutirekasyapyakasasya stanakrtan Bedavyapadesanupapadayati - yo yan bahirDa purusadakasa (Ca. 3.12.8), yo yanantarhrdaya akasa (Ca. 3.12.9) iti / 35 / taTanyapratiseDat
ck: upapatyate catretrsa eva sanpanto nanyatrsa svanapito pavati (ca. 6.8.1) iti hi svarupasanpantanenananananti svarupasya canapayitvat / na naranakaranyayena sanpanto katate / upatikrtasvarupatiropavatu - svanapito pavati (ca. 6.8.1) ityupapatyate / tata peto pi nanyatrsa sanpavati / pahutarasrutiprasitEkesvaratvavirotat / tataca srutirekasyapyakasasya stanakrtan petavyapatesanupapatayati - yo yan pahirta purusatakasa (ca. 3.12.8), yo yanantarhrtaya akasa (ca. 3.12.9) iti / 35 / tatanyapratisetat
s: उपपद्यते चात्रेदृश एव संबन्धो नान्यादृशः ऽस्वमपीतो भवतिऽ (छा. ६.८.१) इति हि स्वरूपसंबन्धमेनमामनन्ति स्वरूपस्य चानपायित्वात् / न नरनगरन्यायेन

pk: evan setvadivyapadesanparapaksahetununaTya sanprati svapaksan hetvantarenopasanharati / taTanyapratiseDapi na brahnana paran vastvantaranastiti ganyate / taTahi - sa evaDastat (Ca. 7.25.1), ahanevaDastat (Ca. 7.25.1), atnEvaDastat (Ca. 7.25.2), sarvan tan paradadyo nyatratnana sarvan veda (br. 2.4.6), brahnEvedan sarvan atnEvedan sarvan (Ca. 7.25.2), neha nanasti kincana (br. 4.4.1), yasnatparan naparanasti kincit (sve. 3.9), tadetadbrahnapurvananaparananantaranabahyan (br. 2.5.19) ityevanadivakyani svaprakaranastanyanyarTatvena parinetunasakyani brahnavyatiriktan vastvantaran varayanti / sarvantarasrutesca na paranatnano nyo ntaratnastityavaDaryate / 36 / anena sarvagatatvanayanasabdadiBya
ck: evan setvativyapatesanparapaksahetununatya sanprati svapaksan hetvantarenopasanharati / tatanyapratisetapi na prahnana paran vastvantaranastiti kanyate / tatahi - sa evatastat (ca. 7.25.1), ahanevatastat (ca. 7.25.1), atnEvatastat (ca. 7.25.2), sarvan tan paratatyo nyatratnana sarvan veta (pr. 2.4.6), prahnEvetan sarvan atnEvetan sarvan (ca. 7.25.2), neha nanasti kincana (pr. 4.4.1), yasnatparan naparanasti kincit (sve. 3.9), tatetatprahnapurvananaparananantaranapahyan (pr. 2.5.19) ityevanativakyani svaprakaranastanyanyartatvena parinetunasakyani prahnavyatiriktan vastvantaran varayanti / sarvantarasrutesca na paranatnano nyo ntaratnastityavataryate / 36 / anena sarvakatatvanayanasaptatipya
s: एवं सेत्वादिव्यपदेशान्परपक्षहेतूनुन्मथ्य संप्रति स्वपक्षं हेत्वान्तरेणोपसंहरति / तथान्यप्रतिषेधापि न ब्रह्मणः परं वस्त्वन्तरमस्तीति गम्यते /

pk: anena setvadivyapadesanirakaranenanyapratiseDasanasrayanena ca sarvagatatvanapyatnana sidDan Bavati / anyaTa hi tana sidyet / setvadivyapadesesu hi nuKyesvangikriyananesu paricCeda atnana prasajyeta setvadinanevatnakatvat / taTanyapratiseDe pyasati vastu vastvantaradvyavartata iti paricCeda evatnana prasajyeta / sarvagatatvan casyayanasabdadiByo vijnayate / ayanasabdo vyaptivacana sabda yavanva ayanakasastavaneso ntarhrdaya akasa (Ca. 8.1.3) akasavatsarvagatasca nitya jyayandiva (Ca. 3.14.3) jyayanakasat nitya sarvagata sTanuracalo yan sanatana (Ba.gi. 2.24)ityevanadayo hi srutisnrtinyaya sarvagatatvanatnano vaboDayanti / 37 / 7 PalaDikaranan / su. 38-41 Palanata upapate
ck: anena setvativyapatesanirakaranenanyapratisetasanasrayanena ca sarvakatatvanapyatnana sitan pavati / anyata hi tana sityet / setvativyapatesesu hi nukyesvankikriyananesu pariceta atnana prasacyeta setvatinanevatnakatvat / tatanyapratisete pyasati vastu vastvantaratvyavartata iti pariceta evatnana prasacyeta / sarvakatatvan casyayanasaptatipyo vicnayate / ayanasapto vyaptivacana sapta yavanva ayanakasastavaneso ntarhrtaya akasa (ca. 8.1.3) akasavatsarvakatasca nitya cyayantiva (ca. 3.14.3) cyayanakasat nitya sarvakata stanuracalo yan sanatana (pa.ki. 2.24)ityevanatayo hi srutisnrtinyaya sarvakatatvanatnano vapotayanti / 37 / 7 palatikaranan / su. 38-41 palanata upapate
s: अनेन सेत्वादिव्यपदेशनिराकरणेनान्यप्रतिषेधसमाश्रयणेन च सर्वगतत्वमप्यात्मनः सिद्धं भवति / अन्यथा हि तन्न सिद्द्येत् / सेत्वादिव्यपदेशेषु हि मु

ck: tasyEva prahnano vyavaharikyanisitrisitavyavipakavastayanayananya svapavo varnyate / yatatistanistavyanisralaksanan karnapalan sansarakocaran trivitan prasitan cantunan kinetatkarnano pavatyahosvitisvaratiti pavati vicarana / tatra tavatpratipatyate palanata isvaratpavitunarhati / kuta - upapate / sa hi sarvatyaksa srstistitisanharanvicitranvitatatesakalavisesapicnatvatkarninan karnanurupan palan sanpatayatityupapatyate / karnanastvanuksanavinasina kalantarapavi palan pavatityanupapanan / apavatavanutpate / syatetat / karna vinasyatsvakalaneva svanurupan palan canayitva vinasyati tatpalan kalantaritan kartra poksyata iti / tatapi na parisutyati prakpoktrsanpantatpalatvanupapate / yatkalan hi yatsukan tukan vatnana pucyate tasyEva loke palatvan prasitan / nahyasanpatasyatnana sukasya tukasya va palatvan pratiyanti lOkika / atocyate na putkarnanantaran palotpata / karnakaryatapurvatpalanutpatsyata iti / tatapi nopapatyate / apurvasyacetanasya kastalostasanasya cetanenaprartitasya pravrtyanupapate / tatastitve ca prananapavat / artapati pranananiti cet / na / isvarasiterartapatiksayat / 38 / pn: istan svarka, anistanavicyatistanayokyan , vyanisran nanusyapokyan / sansaro cananrtipravaho asrayo yasya / srutatvac ca

pk: jEninistvacaryo Darnan Palasya dataran nanyate / ata eva heto srutarupapatesca / sruyate tavadayanarTa svargakano yajeta ityevanadisu vakyesu / tatra ca viDisrutervisayaBavopaganadyaga svargasyotpadaka iti ganyate / anyaTa hyananusWatrko yaga apadyeta tatrasyopadesavEyarTyan syat / nanvanuksanavinasina sarnana Palan nopapadyata iti parityakto yan paksa / nEsa dosa / srutiprananyat / srutiscetprananan yaTayan karnaPalasanabanDa sruta upapadyate taTa kalpayitavya / nacanutpadya kinapyapurvan karna vinasyatkalantaritan Palan datun saknoti / ata karnano va suksna kacidutaravasTa Palasya va purvavasTapurvan nanastiti tarkyate / upapadyate cayanarTan uktena prakarena / isvarastu Palan dadatityanupapanan / avicitrasya karanasya vicitrakaryanupapatervEsanyanErGrnyaprasangadanusWanavEyartyapatesca / tasnadDarnadeva Palaniti / 40 / purvan tu badarayano hetuvyapadesat
ck: cEninistvacaryo tarnan palasya tataran nanyate / ata eva heto srutarupapatesca / sruyate tavatayanarta svarkakano yaceta ityevanatisu vakyesu / tatra ca vitisrutervisayapavopakanatyaka svarkasyotpataka iti kanyate / anyata hyananustatrko yaka apatyeta tatrasyopatesavEyartyan syat / nanvanuksanavinasina sarnana palan nopapatyata iti parityakto yan paksa / nEsa tosa / srutiprananyat / srutiscetprananan yatayan karnapalasanapanta sruta upapatyate tata kalpayitavya / nacanutpatya kinapyapurvan karna vinasyatkalantaritan palan tatun saknoti / ata karnano va suksna kacitutaravasta palasya va purvavastapurvan nanastiti tarkyate / upapatyate cayanartan uktena prakarena / isvarastu palan tatatityanupapanan / avicitrasya karanasya vicitrakaryanupapatervEsanyanErkrnyaprasankatanustanavEyartyapatesca / tasnatarnateva palaniti / 40 / purvan tu patarayano hetuvyapatesat

ck: patarayanastvacarya purvoktanevesvaran palahetun nanyate / kevalakarnano purvatva kevalatpalanityayan paksastusaptena vyavartyate / karnapeksatapurvape ksatva yata tatastvisvaratpalaniti sitanta / kuta - hetuvyapatesat / tarnatarnayorapi hi karayitrtvenesvaro heturvyapatisyate palasya ca tatrtvena esa hyesa satu karna karayati tan yanepyo lokepya uninisate / esa u evasatu karna karayati tan yanato ninisate iti / snaryate cayanarto pakavatkitasu - yo yo yan yan tanun pakta sratayarcitunicati / tasya tasyacalan sratcatan taneva vitatanyahan / sa taya srataya yuktastasyaratananihate / lapate ca tata kananayEva vihitanhitan (7.21) iti / sarvavetantesu cesvarahetuka eva srstayo vyapatisyante / tateva cesvarasya palahetutvan yatsvakarnanurupa praca srcatiti / vicitrakaryanupapatyatayo pi tosa krtaprayatnapeksatvatisvarasya na prasacyante / 41 / iti srikovintapakavatpucyapatasisyasrinacankarapakavatpatakrtO srinacarirakaninansapasye trtiyatyayasya tvitiya pata / 2 / _ _ trtiyatyaye trtiya pata / [atra paraparaprahnavityakunopasanharavivaranan] 1 sarvavetantapratyayatikaranan / su. 1-4 sarvavetantapratyayan cotanatyavisesat

sagunabrahnavisaya pranadivisaya ceyan vijnanaBedaBedacntetyadosa / atra hi karnavadupasananan BedaBedO sanBavata karnavadeva copasanani drswaPalani cocyante / krananuktiPalani ca kanicitsanyagjnanotpatidvarena / tesvesa cinta sanBavati / kin prativedantan vijnanaBeda ahosvineti / tatra purvapaksahetavastavadupanyasyante / nanastavadBedapratipatihetutvan prasidDan jyotiradisu / asti catra vedantantaravihitesu vijnanesvanyadanyanana tEtiriyakan vajasaneyakan kOTunakan sawyayanakanityevanadi / taTa rupaBedo pi karnaBedasya pratipadaka prasidDo vEsvadevyaniksa vajiByo vajina nityevanadisu / asti catra rupaBeda / tadyaTa - sarvavedantapratyayani vijnanani tasninstasninvedante tani tanyeva Bavitunarhanti / kuta - cedanadyavisesat / adigrahanena saKantaraDikaranasidDantasutrodita aBedahetava ihakrsyante / sanyogarupacodanaKyavisesadityarTa / yaTEkasninagnihotre saKaBede pi purusaprayatnastadrsa eva codyate juhuyaditi / evan yo ha vE jyosWan ca sresWan ca veda (br.6.1.1, Ca. 5.1.1) iti vajasaneyinan Candoganan ca tadrsyeva codana / prayojanasanyogo pyavisiswa eva jyesWasca sresWasca svanan Bavati (br. 6.1.1) iti / rupanapyuBayatra tadeva vijnanasya yaduta jyesWasresWadigunavisesana
ck: vyakyatan vicneyasya prahnanastatvan / itanin tu prativetantan vicnanani pityante na veti vicaryate / nanu vicneyan prahna purvaparatipetarahitanekarasan sEntavakanavatavataritan tatra kuto vicnanapetapetacintavatara / nahi karnapahutvavatprahnapahutvanapi vetantesu pratipipatayisitaniti sakyan vaktun / prahnana ekavakyatvatekarupatvaca / nacEkupe prahnanyanetarupani vicnanani sanpavanti / nahyanyatarto nyata cnananityaprantan pavati / yati punarekasninprahnani pahuni vicnanani vetantantaresu pratipipatayisitani tesanekanaprantan prantanitaranityanasvasaprasanko vetantesu / tasnana tavatprativetantan prahnavicnanapeta asankitun sakyate / napyasya cotanatyavisesatapeta ucyate / prahnavicnanasyacotanalaksanatvat / avitipratanErhi vastuparyavasayipirprahnavakyErprahnavicnanan canyata ityavocatacarya tatu sananvayat (pra.su. 1.1.4) ityatra / tatkataninan petapetacintanarapata iti / tatucyate - sakunaprahnavisaya pranativisaya ceyan vicnanapetapetacntetyatosa / atra hi karnavatupasananan petapetO sanpavata karnavateva copasanani trstapalani cocyante / krananuktipalani ca kanicitsanyakcnanotpatitvarena / tesvesa cinta sanpavati / kin prativetantan vicnanapeta ahosvineti / tatra purvapaksahetavastavatupanyasyante / nanastavatpetapratipatihetutvan prasitan cyotiratisu / asti catra vetantantaravihitesu vicnanesvanyatanyanana tEtiriyakan vacasaneyakan kOtunakan satyayanakanityevanati / tata rupapeto pi karnapetasya pratipataka prasito vEsvatevyaniksa vacipyo vacina nityevanatisu / asti catra rupapeta / tatyata - kecicakina pancaknivityayan sastanaparanakninanananyatpare puna pancEva patanti / tata pranasanvatatisu kecitunanvakatinanananti kecitatikan / tata tarnaviseso pi karnapetasya pratipataka asankita kariryatisu / asti catra tarnavisesa / yatatarvanikanan sirovrataniti / evan punaruktyatayo pi petahetavo yatasanpavan vetantantaresu yocayitavya / tasnatprativetantan vicnanapeta iti / evan prapte pruna - sarvavetantapratyayani vicnanani tasninstasninvetante tani tanyeva pavitunarhanti / kuta - cetanatyavisesat / atikrahanena sakantaratikaranasitantasutrotita apetahetava ihakrsyante / sanyokarupacotanakyavisesatityarta / yatEkasninaknihotre sakapete pi purusaprayatnastatrsa eva cotyate cuhuyatiti / evan yo ha vE cyostan ca srestan ca veta (pr.6.1.1, ca. 5.1.1) iti vacasaneyinan cantokanan ca tatrsyeva cotana / prayocanasanyoko pyavisista eva cyestasca srestasca svanan pavati (pr. 6.1.1) iti / rupanapyupayatra tateva vicnanasya yatuta cyestasrestatikunavisesananvit

ck: syatetat / sarvavetantapratyayatvan vicnananan kunapetanopapatyate / tatahi vacasaneyina pancaknivityan prastutya stanaparanakninanananti - tasyaknirevaknirpavati (pr. 6.2.14) ityatina / cantokastu tan nanananti pancasankyayEva ca ta upasanharanti ata ha ya etanevan pancakninveta (ca. 5.10.10) iti / yosan ca sa kuno sti yesan ca nasti katanupayesaneka vityopapatyeta / nacatra kunopasanhara sakyate pratyetun, pancasankyavirotat / tata pranasanvate srestatanyanscatura prananvakcaksu srotananansi cantoka anananti / vacasaneyinastu pancananapyanananti reto vE pracapati pracayate ha pracaya pasupirya evan veta (pr. 6.1.6) iti / avapotvapapetaca vetyapeto pavati vetyapetaca vityapeto travyatevatapetativa yakasyeti cet / nEsa tosa / yata ekasyanapi vityayanevancatiyako kunapeta upapatyate / yatyapi sastasyaknerupasanharo na sanpavati tatapi tyupraprtinan pancananakninanupayatra pratyapicnayananatvana vityapeto pavitunarhati / nahi sotasikrahanakrahanayoratiratro pityate / patyate pi ca sasto kniscantokE - tan pretan tistanito knaya evan haranti (ca. 5.9.2) iti / vacasaneyinastu sanpatikesu pancasvaknisvanuvrtaya sanitunatikalpanaya nivrtaye tasyaknirevaknirpavati sanitsanit (pr. 6.2.14) ityati sananananti sa nityanuvata / atapyupasanarta esa vatastatapi sa kuna sakyatecantokErapyupasanhartun / nacatra pancasankyavirote asankya / sanpatikaknyapipraya hyesa pancasankya nityanuvataputa na vitisanavayinityatosa / evan pranasanvatesvapyatikasya kunasyetaratropasanharo na virutyate / nacavapotvapapetatvetyapeto vityapetascasankya / kasyacitvetyansasyavapotvapayorapi puyaso vetyaraserapetavakanat / tasnatEkavityaneva / 2 / pn: ito snalokan tistan lokantaran pretan katan cnatayo knaye harantityarta / svatyayasya tatatvena hi sanacare tikarac ca savavac ca taniyana

ata ya eso ntaratitye hiranaya puruso trsyate (ca. 1.6.6) ata ya eso ksini puruso trsyate (ca. 4.15.1) ityutaha-tya sEveyanaksyatityapurusavisaya vityopayatrEkEveti krtva satyatinkunanvacasaneyipyascantokananupasanharyananyante / tana satu laksyate / cantokye hi cyotistonakarnasanapantiniyanutkitavyapasraya vitya vicnayate tatra hyatinatyavasanesu hi karnasanpantacihnani pavanti iyanevarkakni sana (ca. 1.6.1) ityupakrane, tasyarka sana ca kesnO tasnatutkita (ca. 1.6.8) iti natye, ya evan vitvansana kayati (ca. 1.7.9) ityupasanhare / nEvan vacasaneyake kincitkarnasanpanti cihnanasti / tatra prakranapetatvityapete sati kunyavastEva yukteti / 38 / pn: kesnO kayakO / tasnatrksanakesnatvat / 25 kanatyatikaratikaranan / su. 39 kanatitaratra tatra cayatanatipya
s: ऽस यो हैतं महद्यक्षं प्रथमजं वेद ब्रह्मऽ (बृ. ५.४.१) इत्यादिना वाजसनेयके सत्यविद्यां सनामाक्षरोपासनां विधायानन्तिमाम्नायते - ऽतद्यत्तत्सत्यम

pk: aTa yadidanasninbrahnapure daharan punqarikan vesna daharo sninantarakasa (Ca. 8.1.1) iti prastutya Candoga aDiyate esa atnapahatapapna vijaro vinrtyurvisoko vijiGatso pipasa satyakana satyasankalpa (Ca. 8.1.5) ityadi / taTa vajasaneyina - sa va esa nahanaja atna yo yan vijnananaya pranesu ya eso ntarhadaya akasastasninCete sarvasya vasi (br. 4.4.2) ityadi / tatra vidyEkatvan parasparagunayogasca kin va neti sansaye vidyEkatvaniti / tatredanucyate - kanaditi / satyakanadityarTa / yaTa devadato data satyaBana Baneti / yadetacandogye hrdayakasasya satyakanatvadigunajatanulaByate taditaratra vajasaneyake vasitvadyupalaByate tadapitaratra Candogye esa atnapahatapapna (Ca. 8.1.5) ityatra sanbaDyate / kuta - ayatanadisananyat / sananan hyuBayanatrapi hrdayanatanan sananasca vedya isvara sananan ca tasya setutvan lokasanBedaprayojananityevanadi bahu sananyan drsyate / nanu viseso / napi drsyate Candogye hrdayakasasya gunayogo vajasaneyake tvakasasrayasya brahnana iti / na / dahara utareBya (bra.su. 1.3.14) ityatra Candogye pyakasasabdan brahnEveti pratisWapitatvat / ayan tvatra vidyate visesa / saguna hi brahnavidya Candogya upadisyate aTa ya ihatnanananuvidya vrajantyetansca satyankanan (Ca. 8.1.6) ityatnavatkanananapi vedyatvasravanat / vajasaneyake tu nirgunaneva paran brahnopadisyananan drsyate ata urDvan vinoksaya bruhi (br. 4.3.14) asango hyayan purusa (br. 4.3.15) ityadiprasnaprativacanasananvayat / vasitvadi tu tatstutyarTaneva gunajatan vajasaneyake sankirtyate / taTacopariswat sa esa neti netyatna (br. 3.9.26) ityadina nirgunaneva brahnopasanharati / gunavatastu brahnana ekatvadviButipradarsanayayan gunopasanhara sutrito nopasanayeti draswavyan / 39 / 26 adaraDikaranan / su. 40-41 adaradalopa
ck: ata yatitanasninprahnapure taharan puntarikan vesna taharo sninantarakasa (ca. 8.1.1) iti prastutya cantoka atiyate esa atnapahatapapna vicaro vinrtyurvisoko vicikatso pipasa satyakana satyasankalpa (ca. 8.1.5) ityati / tata vacasaneyina - sa va esa nahanaca atna yo yan vicnananaya pranesu ya eso ntarhataya akasastasnincete sarvasya vasi (pr. 4.4.2) ityati / tatra vityEkatvan parasparakunayokasca kin va neti sansaye vityEkatvaniti / tatretanucyate - kanatiti / satyakanatityarta / yata tevatato tata satyapana paneti / yatetacantokye hrtayakasasya satyakanatvatikunacatanulapyate tatitaratra vacasaneyake vasitvatyupalapyate tatapitaratra cantokye esa atnapahatapapna (ca. 8.1.5) ityatra sanpatyate / kuta - ayatanatisananyat / sananan hyupayanatrapi hrtayanatanan sananasca vetya isvara sananan ca tasya setutvan lokasanpetaprayocananityevanati pahu sananyan trsyate / nanu viseso / napi trsyate cantokye hrtayakasasya kunayoko vacasaneyake tvakasasrayasya prahnana iti / na / tahara utarepya (pra.su. 1.3.14) ityatra cantokye pyakasasaptan prahnEveti pratistapitatvat / ayan tvatra vityate visesa / sakuna hi prahnavitya cantokya upatisyate ata ya ihatnanananuvitya vracantyetansca satyankanan (ca. 8.1.6) ityatnavatkanananapi vetyatvasravanat / vacasaneyake tu nirkunaneva paran prahnopatisyananan trsyate ata urtvan vinoksaya pruhi (pr. 4.3.14) asanko hyayan purusa (pr. 4.3.15) ityatiprasnaprativacanasananvayat / vasitvati tu tatstutyartaneva kunacatan vacasaneyake sankirtyate / tatacoparistat sa esa neti netyatna (pr. 3.9.26) ityatina nirkunaneva prahnopasanharati / kunavatastu prahnana ekatvatviputipratarsanayayan kunopasanhara sutrito nopasanayeti trastavyan / 39 / 26 ataratikaranan / su. 40-41 ataratalopa
s: अथ यदिदमस्मिन्ब्रह्मपुरे दहरं पुण्डरीकं वेश्म दहरो ऽस्मिन्नन्तराकाशः (छा. ८.१.१) इति प्रस्तुत्य छन्दोगा अधीयते ऽएष आत्मापहतपाप्मा विजरो विमृ

pk: Candogye vEsvanaravidyan prakrtya sruyate - tadyadBaktan praTananagacCetadDoniyan sa yan praTananahutin juhuyatan juhuyatpranasya svaha (Ca. 5.19.1) ityadi / tatra panca pranahutayo vihita / tasu ca parastadagnihotrasabda prayukta ya etadevan vidvanagnihotran juhoti (Ca. 5.24.2) iti yaTeha ksuDita bala nataran paryupasate / evan sarvani Butanyagnihotranupasate (Ca. 5.24.5) iti ca / tatredan vicaryate - kin Bojanalope lopa pranagnihotrasyotalopa itE / tadyadBavati BaktagananasanyogasravanadBaktagananasya ca bojanarTatvadBojanalope lopa pranagnihotrasyeti / evan prapte na lupyeteti tavadaha / kasnat / adarat / taTahi vEsvaravidyayaneva jabalanan sruti - purvo tiTiByo sniyat / yaTa ha vE svayanahutvagnihotran parasya juhuyadevan tat ityatiTiBojanasya praTanyan ninditva svaniBojanan praTanan prapayanti pranagnihotra adaran karoti / ya hi na praTanyalopan sahate netaran sa praTanyavato gnihotrasya lopan sahateti nanyate / nanu BojanarTaBaktagananasanyogadBojanalope lopa praTita / na / tasya dravyavisesaviDanarTatvat / prakrte hyagnihotre payapraBrtinan dravyanan niyatatvadihapyagnihotrasabdatkOnqapayinanayanavatadDarnapraptO satyan BaktadravyEkatagunavisesaviDanarTanidan vakyan tadyadBaktaniti / ato gunalope na nuKyasyetyen praptan / Bojanalope pyadBirvanyena va dravyenavirudDena pratiniDananyayena pranagnihotrasyanusWananiti / 40 / ata utaran paWati - upasTite tastadvacanat
ck: cantokye vEsvanaravityan prakrtya sruyate - tatyatpaktan pratananakacetatoniyan sa yan pratananahutin cuhuyatan cuhuyatpranasya svaha (ca. 5.19.1) ityati / tatra panca pranahutayo vihita / tasu ca parastataknihotrasapta prayukta ya etatevan vitvanaknihotran cuhoti (ca. 5.24.2) iti yateha ksutita pala nataran paryupasate / evan sarvani putanyaknihotranupasate (ca. 5.24.5) iti ca / tatretan vicaryate - kin pocanalope lopa pranaknihotrasyotalopa itE / tatyatpavati paktakananasanyokasravanatpaktakananasya ca pocanartatvatpocanalope lopa pranaknihotrasyeti / evan prapte na lupyeteti tavataha / kasnat / atarat / tatahi vEsvaravityayaneva capalanan sruti - purvo titipyo sniyat / yata ha vE svayanahutvaknihotran parasya cuhuyatevan tat ityatitipocanasya pratanyan nintitva svanipocanan pratanan prapayanti pranaknihotra ataran karoti / ya hi na pratanyalopan sahate netaran sa pratanyavato knihotrasya lopan sahateti nanyate / nanu pocanartapaktakananasanyokatpocanalope lopa pratita / na / tasya travyavisesavitanartatvat / prakrte hyaknihotre payapraprtinan travyanan niyatatvatihapyaknihotrasaptatkOntapayinanayanavatatarnapraptO satyan paktatravyEkatakunavisesavitanartanitan vakyan tatyatpaktaniti / ato kunalope na nukyasyetyen praptan / pocanalope pyatpirvanyena va travyenavirutena pratinitananyayena pranaknihotrasyanustananiti / 40 / ata utaran patati - upastite tastatvacanat
s: छान्दोग्ये वैश्वानरविद्यां प्रकृत्य श्रूयते - ऽतद्यद्भक्तं प्रथममागच्छेत्तद्धोमीयं स यां प्रथमामाहुतिं जुहुयात्तां जुहुयात्प्राणस्य स्वाहाऽ

pk: upasTite Bojane tastasnadeva BojanadravyatpraTanopanipatitatpranagnihotran nirvartayitavyan / kasnat / tadvacanat / taTahi - tadyadBaktan praTananagacCetadDoniyan (Ca. 5.19.1) iti / sidDavadBaktopanipataparanarsena pararTadravyasaDyatan pranahutinan vidaDati / ta aprayojakalaksanapana satya kaTan Bojanalope dravyantaran pratiniDapayeyu / nacatra prakrtagnihotraDarnapraptirasti / kunqapayinanayane hi nasagnihotran juhotiti viDyudesagato gnihotrasabdastadvadBavan vidapayediti yukta tadDarnaprapti / iha punarartavadagato gnihotrasabdo na tadvadBavan viDapayitunarhati / tadDarnapraptO caByupaganyananayanagnyudDaranadayosa-pi prapyeran / nacasti sanBava / agnyudDaranan tavadDonaDikaranaBavaya / nacayanagnO hono BojanarTatavyaGataprasangat / BojanopanitadravyasanbanDacasya evEsa hona / taTaca jabalasruti purvo tiTiByo sniyadityasyaDaranevenan honanirvatin darsayati / ata eva cehapi sanpadikanyevagnihotrangani darsayati - ura eva vedirlonani bahurhrdayan garhapatyo nano nvaharyapacana asyanahavaniya (Ca. 5.18.2) iti / vedisrutiscatra sTanqilanatropalaksanarTa draswavya / nuKyagnihotre vedyaBavat / tadanganan ceha sanpipadayisitatvat / BojanenEva ca krtakalena sanyoganagnihotrakalavaroDasanBava / evananye pyupasTanadayo Darna kecitkaTancidviruDyante / tasnadBojanapaksa evEte nantradravyadevatasanyogatpanca hona nirvartayitavya / yatvadaradarsanavacanan tadBojanapakse praTanyaviDanarTan / nahyasti vacanasyatiBara / na tvanenasya nityata sakyate darsayitun / tasnadBojanalopa eva pranagnihotrasyeti / 41 / 27 tanirDaranaDikaranan / su. 42 tanirDarananiyanastadrswe prTagGyapratibanDa Palan
ck: upastite pocane tastasnateva pocanatravyatpratanopanipatitatpranaknihotran nirvartayitavyan / kasnat / tatvacanat / tatahi - tatyatpaktan pratananakacetatoniyan (ca. 5.19.1) iti / sitavatpaktopanipataparanarsena parartatravyasatyatan pranahutinan vitatati / ta aprayocakalaksanapana satya katan pocanalope travyantaran pratinitapayeyu / nacatra prakrtaknihotratarnapraptirasti / kuntapayinanayane hi nasaknihotran cuhotiti vityutesakato knihotrasaptastatvatpavan vitapayetiti yukta tatarnaprapti / iha punarartavatakato knihotrasapto na tatvatpavan vitapayitunarhati / tatarnapraptO capyupakanyananayanaknyutaranatayosa-pi prapyeran / nacasti sanpava / aknyutaranan tavatonatikaranapavaya / nacayanaknO hono pocanartatavyakataprasankat / pocanopanitatravyasanpantacasya evEsa hona / tataca capalasruti purvo titipyo sniyatityasyataranevenan honanirvatin tarsayati / ata eva cehapi sanpatikanyevaknihotrankani tarsayati - ura eva vetirlonani pahurhrtayan karhapatyo nano nvaharyapacana asyanahavaniya (ca. 5.18.2) iti / vetisrutiscatra stantilanatropalaksanarta trastavya / nukyaknihotre vetyapavat / tatankanan ceha sanpipatayisitatvat / pocanenEva ca krtakalena sanyokanaknihotrakalavarotasanpava / evananye pyupastanatayo tarna kecitkatancitvirutyante / tasnatpocanapaksa evEte nantratravyatevatasanyokatpanca hona nirvartayitavya / yatvataratarsanavacanan tatpocanapakse pratanyavitanartan / nahyasti vacanasyatipara / na tvanenasya nityata sakyate tarsayitun / tasnatpocanalopa eva pranaknihotrasyeti / 41 / 27 tanirtaranatikaranan / su. 42 tanirtarananiyanastatrste prtakyapratipanta palan
s: उपस्थिते भोजने ऽतस्तस्मादेव भोजनद्रव्यात्प्रथमोपनिपतितात्प्राणाग्निहोत्रं निर्वर्तयितव्यम् / कस्मात् / तद्वचनात् / तथाहि - ऽतद्यद्भक्तं प्रथ

pk: santi karnangavyapasrayani vijnanani - onityetadaksaranudgiTanupasita (Ca. 1.1.1) ityevanadini / kin tani nityanyeva syu karnasu parnanayitvadivadutanityani godohanadivaditi vicarayana / kin tavatpraptan - nityaniti / kuta - prayogavacanaparigrahat / anaraByaDitanyapi hyetanyudgiTadidvarena kratusanbanDatkratuprayogavacanenEvangantaravatsansprsyante / yatvesan svavakyesu Palasravanan apayita ha vEkananan Bavati (Ca. 1.1.7) ityadi tadvartananapadesarupatvadarTavadanatranevapapaslokasravanadivana Palapradanan / tasnadyaTa yasya parnanayi juhurBavati na sa papan slokan srnoti ityevanadinanaprakaranapaWitananapi juhvadidvarena kratupravesatprakaranapaWitavanityatEvanudgiTadyupasanananapiti / evan prapte bruna - tanirDarananiyana iti / yanyetanyudgiTadikarnagunayaTatnyanirDaranani rasatana apti sanrdDirnuKyaprana aditya ityevanadini nEtani nityavatkarnasu niyanyeran / kuta - tadrswe / taTahyaniyatatvanevanjatiyakanan darsayati sruti - tenoBO kuruto yascEtadevan veda yasca na veda (Ca. 1.10) ityaviduso pi kriyaByanujnanat / prastavadidevatavijnanavihinananapi prastotradinan yajanaDyavasanadarsanat prastotarya devata prastavananvayata tan cedavidvanprastosyasi (Ca. 1.10.9) tan cedavidvanudgasyasi (Ca. 1.10.10) tan cedavidvanpratiharisyasi (Ca. 1.10.1) iti ca / api cEvanjatiyakasya karnavyapasrayasya vijnanasya prTageva karnana PalanupalaByate karnaPalasidDidyapratibanDastatsanrdDiratisayavisesa kascit tenoBO kuruto yascEtadevan veda yasca na veda / nana tu vidya cavidya ca yadeva vidyaya karoti sradDayopanisada tadeva viryavataran Bavati (Ca. 1.1.10) iti / tatra nana tviti vidvadavidvatprayogayo prTakaranadviyarvataraniti ca tarapratyayaprayogadvidyavihinanapi karnaviryavaditi ganyate / tacanityatve vidyaya upapadyate / nityatve tu kaTan tadvihinan karnaviryavadityanujnayeta / sarvangopasanhare hi viryavatkarneti sTiti / taTa lokasanadisu pratiniyatani pratyupasanan Palani sisyante kalpante hasnE loka urDvascavrtasca (Ca. 2.2.3) ityevanadini, nacedan PalasravananarTavadanatran yuktan pratipatun / taTahi gunavada apadyeta / Palopadese tu nuKyavadopapati / prayajadisu tvitikartavyatakanksasya krato prakrtatvatadarTye sati yuktan PalasruterarTavadatvan / taTanaraByaDitesvapi parnanayitvadisu / nahi parnanayitvadinanakriyatnakananasrayanantarena PalasanbanDo vakalpate / godohanadinan hi prakrtapranayanadyasrayalaBadupapana PalaviDi / taTa bElvadinanapi prakrtayupadyasrayalaBadupapana PalaviDi / natu parnanayitvadisvevanviDa kascidasraya prakrto sti / vakyenEva tu juh
ck: santi karnankavyapasrayani vicnanani - onityetataksaranutkitanupasita (ca. 1.1.1) ityevanatini / kin tani nityanyeva syu karnasu parnanayitvativatutanityani kotohanativatiti vicarayana / kin tavatpraptan - nityaniti / kuta - prayokavacanaparikrahat / anarapyatitanyapi hyetanyutkitatitvarena kratusanpantatkratuprayokavacanenEvankantaravatsansprsyante / yatvesan svavakyesu palasravanan apayita ha vEkananan pavati (ca. 1.1.7) ityati tatvartananapatesarupatvatartavatanatranevapapaslokasravanativana palapratanan / tasnatyata yasya parnanayi cuhurpavati na sa papan slokan srnoti ityevanatinanaprakaranapatitananapi cuhvatitvarena kratupravesatprakaranapatitavanityatEvanutkitatyupasanananapiti / evan prapte pruna - tanirtarananiyana iti / yanyetanyutkitatikarnakunayatatnyanirtaranani rasatana apti sanrtirnukyaprana atitya ityevanatini nEtani nityavatkarnasu niyanyeran / kuta - tatrste / tatahyaniyatatvanevancatiyakanan tarsayati sruti - tenopO kuruto yascEtatevan veta yasca na veta (ca. 1.10) ityavituso pi kriyapyanucnanat / prastavatitevatavicnanavihinananapi prastotratinan yacanatyavasanatarsanat prastotarya tevata prastavananvayata tan cetavitvanprastosyasi (ca. 1.10.9) tan cetavitvanutkasyasi (ca. 1.10.10) tan cetavitvanpratiharisyasi (ca. 1.10.1) iti ca / api cEvancatiyakasya karnavyapasrayasya vicnanasya prtakeva karnana palanupalapyate karnapalasitityapratipantastatsanrtiratisayavisesa kascit tenopO kuruto yascEtatevan veta yasca na veta / nana tu vitya cavitya ca yateva vityaya karoti sratayopanisata tateva viryavataran pavati (ca. 1.1.10) iti / tatra nana tviti vitvatavitvatprayokayo prtakaranatviyarvataraniti ca tarapratyayaprayokatvityavihinanapi karnaviryavatiti kanyate / tacanityatve vityaya upapatyate / nityatve tu katan tatvihinan karnaviryavatityanucnayeta / sarvankopasanhare hi viryavatkarneti stiti / tata lokasanatisu pratiniyatani pratyupasanan palani sisyante kalpante hasnE loka urtvascavrtasca (ca. 2.2.3) ityevanatini, nacetan palasravananartavatanatran yuktan pratipatun / tatahi kunavata apatyeta / palopatese tu nukyavatopapati / prayacatisu tvitikartavyatakanksasya krato prakrtatvatatartye sati yuktan palasruterartavatatvan / tatanarapyatitesvapi parnanayitvatisu / nahi parnanayitvatinanakriyatnakananasrayanantarena palasanpanto vakalpate / kotohanatinan hi prakrtapranayanatyasrayalapatupapana palaviti / tata pElvatinanapi prakrtayupatyasrayalapatupapana palaviti / natu parnanayitvatisvevanvita kascitasraya prakrto sti / vakyenEva tu cuhvaty

pk: vajasaneyake - vadisyanyevahaniti vagdaDre (br. 1.5.21) ityatraDyatnan vagadinan sresWo vaDarito DidEvatanagnyadinan vayu taTa Candogye - vayurvava sanvarga (Ca. 4.3.1) ityatraDidEvatanagnyadinan vayu sarngo vaDarita prano vava sanvarga (Ca. 4.3.2) ityatraDyatnan vagadinan prana / tatra sansaya - kin prTagevenO vayupranavupagantavyO syatanaprTagveti / aprTageveti tavatpraptan tatvaBedat / nahyaBine tatve prTaganucintanan nyayan / darsayati ca srutiraDyatnanaDidEvatan ca tatvaBedan - agnirvagButva nuKan pravisat (E. 2.4) ityaraBya / taTa ta ete sarva eva sana sarvo nanta (br. 1.5.13) ityaDyatnikanan pranananaDidEvikin vibutinatnaButan darsayati / taTanyatrapi tatra tatraDyatnanaDidEvatan ca bahuDa tatvaBedadarsanan Bavati / kvacica ya prana sa vayu iti spaswaneva vayun pranan cEkan karoti / taTodahrte pi vajasaneyibrahnane yatascedeti surya (br. 1.5.23) ityasninupasanharasloke pranadva esa udeti prane staneti (br. 1.5.23) iti pranenEvopasanharanetvan darsayati / tasnadekaneva vratan caretpranyacEvapayanyaca (br. 1.5.23) iti ca pranavratenEkenopasanharenetadeva draQayati / taTa Candogye pi parastat nahatnanascaturo deva eka ka sa jagara Buvanasya gopa (Ca. 4.3.6) ityekaneva sanvargan ganayati na bravityeka ekesan caturnan sanvargo paro paresaniti / tasnadaprTaktvanupagananasyeti / evan prapte bruna -
